Name: Snack Stackers
Preparation: Layer a cracker with a slice of cheese and a piece of salami.
Repeat to create a stack and serve as a quick snack.

Name: Banana Smoothie
Preparation: Peel and chop the banana into chunks.
Blend the banana, milk, and honey until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve chilled.

Name: Bruschetta
Preparation: Slice the baguette into thin pieces and toast until crispy.
Dice tomatoes and mix with chopped basil, olive oil, and minced garlic.
Spoon the tomato mixture onto the toasted bread slices and serve.

Name: Cheese Balls
Preparation: Mix cream cheese and shredded cheddar cheese in a bowl.
Roll the mixture into small balls.
Coat the balls in breadcrumbs and refrigerate until firm before serving.

Name: Spanish Bruschetta
Preparation: Slice the baguette into thin pieces and toast until crispy.
Dice tomatoes and mix with olive oil.
Spoon the tomato mixture onto the toasted bread and top with a slice of Serrano ham.

Name: Alpine Pasta
Preparation: Cook pasta according to package instructions and drain.
Heat heavy cream in a pan, add grated Gruyere cheese, and stir until melted.
Toss the cooked pasta in the cheese sauce and serve hot.

Name: Italian Risotto
Preparation: Heat chicken broth in a pot and keep it simmering.
In a separate pan, melt butter and sauté Arborio rice for 2 minutes.
Gradually add broth to the rice, stirring constantly until absorbed, for about 20 minutes.
Stir in grated Parmesan cheese and serve warm.

Name: Alpine Gnocchi
Preparation: Cook gnocchi in boiling water until they float to the surface, then drain.
Melt butter in a pan, add sage leaves, and sauté until fragrant.
Toss the cooked gnocchi in the butter sauce, sprinkle with Parmesan, and serve.

Name: Mixed Nuts (Almonds and Brazil Nuts)
Preparation: Combine almonds and Brazil nuts in a bowl.
Serve as a snack or store in an airtight container.

Name: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
Preparation: Preheat oven to 150°C (300°F).
Toss pumpkin seeds with olive oil and salt.
Spread seeds on a baking sheet and roast for 30-40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden and crispy.

Name: Sliced Apple with Peanut Butter
Preparation: Wash and slice the apple into thin wedges.
Spread peanut butter evenly on each apple slice and serve.

Name: Boiled Sweet Corn
Preparation: Remove the husk and silk from the sweet corn.
Boil the corn in a pot of water with a pinch of salt for 10-15 minutes until tender.
Drain the water, optionally rub butter on the corn, and serve hot.

Name: Whole Wheat Banana Walnut Muffin
Preparation: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Mash the banana in a bowl and mix with sugar and oil.
Add whole wheat flour, baking powder, and walnuts to form a batter.
Pour the batter into a muffin tin and bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown.
Let it cool and serve.

Name: Tomato and Cucumber Sandwich
Preparation: Spread butter or cream cheese on two slices of bread.
Layer sliced tomato and cucumber on one slice.
Cover with the second slice of bread, cut into halves, and serve.

Name: Pumpkin Seed and Almond Trail Mix
Preparation: Mix pumpkin seeds and almonds in a bowl.
Store in an airtight container or serve immediately as a snack.
image_path: data/final_images\Pumpkin Seed and Almond Trail Mix.jpg

Name: Ragi and Jaggery Cookies
Preparation: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Mix ragi flour, jaggery, butter, and baking powder to form a dough.
Shape the dough into small cookies and place on a baking tray.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until crisp, then let cool before serving.

Name: Cucumber Mint Yogurt Dip with Carrots
Preparation: Mix grated cucumber, chopped mint, and salt into the yogurt to make the dip.
Cut carrots into sticks for dipping.
Serve the yogurt dip with carrot sticks.
image_path: data/final_images\Cucumber Mint Yogurt Dip with Carrots.jpg

Name: Walnut and Fig Bliss Balls
Preparation: Blend walnuts and dried figs in a food processor until sticky.
Add honey and mix well.
Roll the mixture into small balls and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

Name: Tomato Basil Soup
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a pot and sauté onions and garlic until translucent.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook for 10 minutes until soft.
Pour in vegetable broth, add basil leaves, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend the mixture until smooth, then serve hot.
image_path: data/final_images\Creamy Tomato Basil Soup with Grilled Cheese.webp

Name: Roasted Sunflower Seeds
Preparation: Preheat the oven to 150°C (300°F).
Spread sunflower seeds on a baking tray and sprinkle with salt.
Roast for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden and crisp.
Let cool and serve as a snack.

Name: Chicken Bone Broth
Preparation: Place chicken bones in a large pot and cover with water.
Add chopped carrots, celery, onion, garlic, bay leaves, and salt.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer for 12-24 hours, skimming off any foam.
Strain the broth through a fine mesh sieve and let cool before storing.
image_path: data/final_images\Chicken Bone Broth with Boiled Egg.jpg

Name: Baked Sweet Potato Fries
Preparation: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Peel and cut sweet potatoes into thin strips.
Toss with olive oil, salt, and paprika.
Spread on a baking sheet in a single layer and bake for 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway, until crispy.

Name: Avocado and Cacao Mousse
Preparation: Scoop out the avocado flesh into a blender.
Add cacao powder, honey, and vanilla extract.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving.

Name: Walnuts and Raisins
Preparation: Measure out walnuts and raisins.
Mix together in a bowl or store in an airtight container as a snack.

Name: Greek Yogurt with Sunflower Seeds
Preparation: Scoop Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Sprinkle sunflower seeds on top.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.

Name: Carrot and Ginger Soup
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a pot and sauté chopped onion and ginger until fragrant.
Add chopped carrots and vegetable broth, bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until carrots are tender.
Blend until smooth, season with salt, and serve hot.

Name: Roasted Red Bell Pepper Soup
Preparation: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and roast bell peppers for 20-25 minutes until charred.
Peel off the skin and remove seeds from peppers.
Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil, then add roasted peppers and broth.
Simmer for 15 minutes, blend until smooth, season with salt, and serve.

Name: Quinoa and Lentil Salad
Preparation: Cook quinoa and lentils separately according to package instructions, then cool.
Chop cherry tomatoes and cucumber into small pieces.
Mix quinoa, lentils, tomatoes, and cucumber in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, season with salt, and toss to combine.

Name: Kiwi and Chia Seed Bowl
Preparation: Peel and slice kiwi into bite-sized pieces.
Mix chia seeds with Greek yogurt and let sit for 5 minutes.
Layer yogurt mixture and kiwi in a bowl.
Drizzle with honey and serve.

Name: Boiled Green Peas
Preparation: Bring water to a boil in a pot and add salt.
Add green peas and cook for 3-5 minutes until tender.
Drain the water and serve warm as a side dish.

Name: Carrot and Tomato Soup
Preparation: Peel and chop carrots, tomatoes, onion, and garlic.
Heat olive oil in a pot, sauté onion and garlic until translucent.
Add carrots and tomatoes, cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth, bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend the mixture until smooth, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.

Name: Roasted Soybeans
Preparation: Soak soybeans overnight, then drain and pat dry.
Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
Toss soybeans with olive oil, salt, and paprika.
Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 30-40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until crispy.
Let cool and serve as a snack.

Name: Carrot and Celery Soup
Preparation: Peel and chop carrots, celery, onion, and garlic.
Heat olive oil in a pot, sauté onion and garlic until translucent.
Add carrots and celery, cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth, bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.

Name: Tomato and Cucumber Salad
Preparation: Chop tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion into bite-sized pieces.
In a bowl, mix olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper to make a dressing.
Toss the vegetables with the dressing and serve fresh.

Name: Spinach and Cucumber Smoothie
Preparation: Wash spinach and peel cucumber and banana.
Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend until smooth, adding more water if needed for desired consistency.
Pour into a glass and serve chilled.

Name: Hard Boiled Eggs with Black Pepper
Preparation: Place eggs in a saucepan and cover with cold water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cool eggs in cold water, peel, and sprinkle with salt and black pepper before serving.
image_path: data/final_images\Hard Boiled Eggs with Black Pepper.jpg

Name: Watermelon and Basil Salad
Preparation: Cut watermelon into bite-sized cubes.
Tear basil leaves and crumble feta cheese.
In a bowl, mix olive oil, lemon juice, and salt to make a dressing.
Toss watermelon, basil, and feta with the dressing and serve chilled.

Name: Tomato and Basil Soup
Preparation: Chop tomatoes, onion, and garlic.
Heat olive oil in a pot, sauté onion and garlic until translucent.
Add tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth, bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Add basil leaves, blend until smooth, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.

Name: Carrot and Beetroot Salad
Preparation: Peel and grate carrots and beetroot.
In a bowl, mix olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper to make a dressing.
Toss the grated vegetables with the dressing and serve fresh.

Name: Hard Boiled Egg Whites with Turmeric
Preparation: Place eggs in a saucepan and cover with cold water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cool eggs in cold water, peel, and remove yolks.
Sprinkle egg whites with turmeric and salt before serving.
image_path: data/final_images\Hard Boiled Egg Whites with Turmeric.jpg

Name: Roasted Bell Pepper Soup
Preparation: Preheat oven to 200°C. Place bell peppers on a baking tray and roast for 20-25 minutes until charred.
Remove peppers from oven, let cool, then peel off the skin and remove seeds.
In a pot, heat olive oil, sauté onion and garlic until translucent.
Add roasted bell peppers and vegetable broth. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend the mixture until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Serve hot.

Name: Spinach and Celery Juice
Preparation: Wash spinach leaves and celery stalks thoroughly.
Chop the apple into small pieces.
Blend spinach, celery, apple, and water in a blender until smooth.
Strain the juice if desired. Add lemon juice and stir. Serve chilled.

Name: Guava and Pomegranate Salad
Preparation: Cut guava into small cubes and deseed if necessary.
Mix guava cubes and pomegranate seeds in a bowl.
Drizzle lemon juice and honey over the fruits. Garnish with chopped mint leaves.
Toss gently and serve fresh.

Name: Bottle Gourd (Lauki) Soup
Preparation: Peel and chop bottle gourd into small pieces.
Heat olive oil in a pot, sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add chopped bottle gourd and vegetable broth. Cook for 15 minutes until tender.
Blend the mixture until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Serve hot.

Name: Steamed Sweet Corn Salad
Preparation: Steam sweet corn kernels for 5-7 minutes until tender.
Chop red bell pepper and green onion finely.
In a bowl, mix steamed corn, bell pepper, and green onion.
Drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil. Add salt and toss well. Serve fresh.

Name: Cabbage and Carrot Slaw
Preparation: Shred cabbage and grate carrot finely.
In a bowl, mix cabbage and carrot together.
Add yogurt, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
Refrigerate for 10 minutes before serving.

Name: Sauted Mushrooms with Garlic
Preparation: Clean and slice mushrooms thinly.
Heat olive oil in a pan, add minced garlic, and sauté for 1 minute.
Add mushrooms and cook for 5-7 minutes until tender.
Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with chopped parsley. Serve hot.

Name: Tomato and Coriander Juice
Preparation: Wash and chop tomatoes into small pieces.
Blend tomatoes, coriander leaves, and water in a blender until smooth.
Strain the juice if desired. Add lemon juice and salt. Stir well.
Serve chilled.

Name: Cucumber and Dill Salad
Preparation: Peel and slice cucumber thinly.
Chop fresh dill finely.
In a bowl, mix cucumber slices with yogurt, lemon juice, and salt.
Garnish with chopped dill. Serve chilled.

Name: Sauted Spinach with Lemon
Preparation: Wash spinach leaves thoroughly and roughly chop them.
Heat olive oil in a pan, add minced garlic, and sauté for 1 minute.
Add spinach and cook for 2-3 minutes until wilted.
Drizzle with lemon juice, season with salt and pepper. Serve hot.

Name: Beetroot and Mint Salad
Preparation: Boil the beetroot until tender, then peel and dice into small cubes.
In a bowl, mix the diced beetroot with chopped mint leaves.
Drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil, then season with salt.
Toss everything together and serve chilled.

Name: Lemon Tea with Mint
Preparation: Boil water in a pot or kettle.
Add tea leaves or a tea bag and let it steep for 2-3 minutes.
Strain the tea into a cup, add lemon juice and fresh mint leaves.
Stir in honey if desired, and serve hot.

Name: Mixed Nuts (Almonds and Walnuts)
Preparation: Measure equal portions of almonds and walnuts.
Mix them together in a small bowl or container.
Serve as a snack.

Name: Apple with Cinnamon Powder
Preparation: Wash and core the apple, then slice it into wedges or bite-sized pieces.
Sprinkle cinnamon powder evenly over the apple slices.
Serve immediately.

Name: Orange Segments
Preparation: Peel the orange and separate it into individual segments.
Remove any seeds or excess pith if necessary.
Serve fresh.

Name: Strawberry and Banana Smoothie
Preparation: Wash and hull the strawberries if using fresh ones.
Peel the banana and cut it into chunks.
Add strawberries, banana, milk, and honey (if using) to a blender.
Blend until smooth and serve immediately.

Name: Sliced Pear
Preparation: Wash the pear and slice it into wedges or thin slices.
Remove the core and seeds if desired.
Serve fresh.

Name: Roasted Pumpkin and Sunflower Seeds
Preparation: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Mix pumpkin seeds and sunflower seeds with olive oil and salt in a bowl.
Spread the seeds on a baking tray in a single layer.
Roast for 10-12 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden and crispy.
Let cool and serve as a snack.

Name: Kiwi and Chia Seed Drink
Preparation: Peel and chop the kiwi into small pieces.
Soak chia seeds in water for 10-15 minutes until they form a gel-like consistency.
Blend the kiwi with water and honey (if using) until smooth.
Mix in the soaked chia seeds and serve chilled.

Name: Cashew and Pistachio Mix
Preparation: Measure equal portions of cashews and pistachios.
Mix them together in a small bowl or container.
Serve as a snack.

Name: Coconut Milk and Papaya Smoothie
Preparation: Add coconut milk, papaya, banana, and ice cubes to a blender.
Blend until smooth and serve immediately.

Name: Oats and Almond Butter Balls
Preparation: Mix all ingredients in a bowl until well combined.
Roll the mixture into small balls and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

Name: Pomegranate and Yogurt
Preparation: Scoop Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Sprinkle pomegranate seeds on top and serve.

Name: Beetroot and Mint Soup
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a pot, add chopped beetroot, and sauté for 5 minutes.
Add vegetable broth, bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend the mixture with mint leaves until smooth, then serve warm.

Name: Pineapple and Cucumber Salad
Preparation: Combine pineapple and cucumber in a bowl.
Drizzle with lime juice, sprinkle mint on top, and toss gently before serving.

Name: Avocado on Rice Cakes
Preparation: Mash avocado with lemon juice in a bowl.
Spread the avocado mixture on rice cakes and serve.

Name: Pumpkin Seeds and Walnuts Mix
Preparation: Mix pumpkin seeds and walnuts in a bowl.
Serve as a snack or store in an airtight container.

Name: Iced Hibiscus Tea
Preparation: Boil water and steep hibiscus flowers for 5-10 minutes.
Strain, add honey, let it cool, then pour over ice and serve.

Name: Chorizo and Egg Burritos
Preparation: Cook chorizo in a pan over medium heat until browned.
Whisk eggs and scramble them in the same pan with chorizo.
Place the mixture on tortilla wraps, sprinkle cheese, roll up, and serve.

Name: Bow Tie Pepperoni Pasta Salad
Preparation: Cook pasta according to package instructions, then cool.
Mix pasta with pepperoni, cherry tomatoes, and Italian dressing in a bowl.
Chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving.

Name: BLT Pasta Salad
Preparation: Cook pasta according to package instructions, then drain and cool.
Cook bacon until crispy, then crumble into small pieces.
Halve cherry tomatoes and chop lettuce.
In a large bowl, mix pasta, bacon, tomatoes, lettuce, and mayonnaise. Chill before serving.

Name: Cheese Tortellini Pesto Pasta Salad
Preparation: Cook tortellini according to package instructions, then drain and cool.
In a large bowl, toss tortellini with pesto sauce.
Add halved cherry tomatoes and mozzarella balls. Mix well and refrigerate before serving.

Name: Baked Chicken Tenders
Preparation: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Beat egg in a bowl. Dip chicken strips in egg, then coat with breadcrumbs.
Place on a baking sheet drizzled with olive oil. Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden and cooked through.

Name: Easy Enchiladas
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Fill tortillas with shredded chicken, roll up, and place in a baking dish.
Pour enchilada sauce over the top and sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 20 minutes until cheese is melted.

Name: Fast Chicken and Rice
Preparation: In a large skillet, cook chicken until no longer pink.
Add rice, chicken broth, and vegetables. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes until rice is tender.

Name: 5 Ingredient Spaghetti
Preparation: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions, then drain.
In a skillet, cook ground beef with onion and garlic until browned. Add tomato sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve sauce over spaghetti.

Name: Chicken Breast with Honey Balsamic Glaze
Preparation: In a small bowl, mix honey and balsamic vinegar.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook chicken breast for 6-8 minutes per side until cooked through.
Brush glaze over chicken during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
image_path: data/final_images\Chicken Breast with Honey Balsamic Glaze.jpg

Name: Healthy Egg Salad Sandwich
Preparation: Chop hard-boiled eggs and mix with Greek yogurt, celery, and mustard in a bowl.
Spread the egg salad on whole grain bread to make a sandwich.

Name: Lunchbox Pizza Quesadilla
Preparation: Spread pizza sauce on one half of the tortilla. Add cheese and pepperoni on top.
Fold tortilla in half and cook in a skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side until cheese is melted.

Name: Ground Beef and Potatoes
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a skillet. Add potatoes and cook for 10 minutes until slightly tender.
Add ground beef and onion. Cook until beef is browned and potatoes are fully cooked, about 10 more minutes. Season to taste.

Name: Cheesy Turkey Burger
Preparation: Form ground turkey into patties and season with salt and pepper.
Grill or pan-fry patties for 5-7 minutes on each side until fully cooked.
Add cheddar cheese on top of the patty during the last minute of cooking to melt.
Toast the burger bun, then assemble with lettuce, tomato, and the cheesy turkey patty.

Name: Tomato and Egg Muffin
Preparation: Toast the English muffin and spread butter on both halves.
Fry the egg to your desired doneness.
Slice the tomato thinly.
Assemble the muffin with the egg, tomato slices, and cheddar cheese on top.

Name: Easy Cheese-Tomato Melt
Preparation: Butter one side of each bread slice.
Slice the tomato thinly and layer on the unbuttered side of one bread slice.
Add cheddar cheese on top of the tomato.
Top with another bread slice (buttered side out) and grill in a pan until the cheese melts and bread is golden brown.

Name: Cheater's Chicken Noodle Soup
Preparation: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a pot.
Add egg noodles and sliced carrot, cooking until noodles are tender (about 8 minutes).
Stir in cooked chicken and heat through for 2-3 minutes before serving.

Name: Ground Chicken Ranch Burger
Preparation: Mix ground chicken with ranch seasoning and form into patties.
Grill or pan-fry patties for 5-7 minutes on each side until fully cooked.
Toast the burger bun, then assemble with lettuce, tomato, and the chicken patty.

Name: Mushroom Quesadilla
Preparation: Sauté sliced mushrooms and onions in butter until soft.
Place half of the cheese on one side of the tortilla, add mushroom mixture, then top with remaining cheese.
Fold the tortilla and cook in a skillet until the cheese melts and tortilla is golden on both sides.

Name: Boston Fenway Franks
Preparation: Grill or boil the hot dog sausage until heated through.
Place the sausage in the hot dog bun.
Top with mustard and relish before serving.

Name: Original Praline Bacon
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix brown sugar and chopped pecans in a bowl.
Lay bacon strips on a baking sheet, sprinkle the sugar-pecan mixture on top, and bake for 15-20 minutes until crispy.

Name: Lasagna
Preparation: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
Brown ground beef in a skillet, then mix with tomato sauce.
Layer noodles, beef sauce, ricotta, and mozzarella in a baking dish. Repeat layers.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30-40 minutes until bubbly and cheese is melted.

Name: Skillet Beans 'n Wieners
Preparation: Slice hot dog sausages into bite-sized pieces.
Sauté chopped onion in a skillet until soft.
Add sausage pieces and baked beans to the skillet, cooking until heated through (about 5-7 minutes).

Name: Baked Buffalo Wings
Preparation: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Arrange chicken wings on a baking sheet and bake for 40-45 minutes until crispy.
Melt butter in a saucepan, mix with hot sauce, and toss the baked wings in the sauce.

Name: Ratatouille in the Crock Pot
Preparation: Chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Place vegetables in a crock pot, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Cook on low for 6-8 hours until vegetables are tender.

Name: Baked Stuffed Pasta Shells
Preparation: Cook pasta shells according to package instructions and drain.
Mix ricotta cheese with herbs and stuff into cooked shells.
Place stuffed shells in a baking dish, cover with marinara sauce and mozzarella, then bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25 minutes.

Name: Roasted Butternut Squash-Quinoa Veggie Burger
Preparation: Roast butternut squash at 400°F (200°C) for 30 minutes until soft, then mash.
Cook quinoa and mix with mashed squash, black beans, and breadcrumbs to form patties.
Fry patties in olive oil over medium heat for 3-4 minutes per side until golden.

Name: Grilled Chicken Avocado Sandwich
Preparation: Season and grill chicken breast in olive oil for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through.
Slice avocado and layer on bread with lettuce and grilled chicken.
Assemble sandwich and serve.

Name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Soy Sauce
Preparation: Chop vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large pan over high heat.
Add vegetables, stir-fry for 5-7 minutes, then add soy sauce and cook for another 2 minutes.

Name: Chicken Pasta with Tomato Sauce
Preparation: Cook pasta according to package instructions and drain.
Cut chicken into pieces, season, and cook in olive oil over medium heat for 6-8 minutes.
Add tomato sauce to chicken, simmer for 5 minutes, then mix with cooked pasta.

Name: Egg Fried Rice
Preparation: Heat vegetable oil in a large pan or wok over medium heat.
Scramble eggs in the pan, then remove and set aside.
Add rice and green onions to the pan, stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, then add soy sauce and scrambled eggs, mixing well.

Name: Turkey Cheese Sandwich
Preparation: Spread mayonnaise on bread slices.
Layer turkey slices, cheese, and lettuce on one slice of bread.
Top with another slice of bread and serve.

Name: Chicken Fajita Wrap
Preparation: Slice chicken, bell peppers, and onion into strips.
Heat olive oil in a pan, cook chicken for 5-6 minutes, then add peppers and onion, cooking for another 5 minutes.
Place mixture in the center of a tortilla, fold, and serve.

Name: Caprese Sandwich
Preparation: Slice the bread and layer with sliced mozzarella and tomato.
Add fresh basil leaves and drizzle with olive oil.
Top with another slice of bread and serve.

Name: Beef Stir Fry with Soy Sauce
Preparation: Heat oil in a pan and sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add beef strips and cook until browned.
Add sliced bell peppers and onion, stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce, mix well, and cook for another 2 minutes before serving.
image_path: data/final_images\Beef Stir Fry with Soy Sauce.webp

Name: Veggie Omelette
Preparation: Beat eggs in a bowl and season with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in a pan, sauté chopped vegetables for 2 minutes.
Pour in the beaten eggs and cook on medium heat until set.
Fold and serve hot.

Name: Chicken Salad with Dressing
Preparation: Chop lettuce, cucumber, and tomato into bite-sized pieces.
Slice grilled chicken breast and mix with vegetables in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and toss to combine before serving.

Name: Grilled Fish with Lemon Butter
Preparation: Season fish fillet with salt and set aside.
Melt butter in a pan, add garlic and lemon juice to make sauce.
Grill fish on medium heat for 3-4 minutes per side.
Drizzle lemon butter sauce over the grilled fish and serve.

Name: Chicken Stir Fry with Vegetables
Preparation: Cut chicken into strips and vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Heat oil in a pan, add chicken, and cook until browned.
Add vegetables and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce, mix well, and cook for another 2 minutes.

Name: Chicken Omelette
Preparation: Beat eggs in a bowl and season with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in a pan, sauté chopped onion for 2 minutes.
Add shredded cooked chicken, then pour in the beaten eggs.
Cook on medium heat until set, fold, and serve.

Name: Chicken Vegetable Soup
Preparation: Chop vegetables and chicken into small pieces.
In a pot, bring chicken broth to a boil.
Add chicken and vegetables, simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve hot.

Name: Egg and Vegetable Stir Fry
Preparation: Beat eggs in a bowl and set aside.
Heat oil in a pan, sauté chopped vegetables for 5 minutes.
Pour in beaten eggs and stir-fry until cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve.

Name: Chicken Capsicum Stir Fry
Preparation: Cut chicken and capsicum into strips.
Heat oil in a pan, add chicken, and cook until browned.
Add capsicum and onion, stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce, mix well, and cook for another 2 minutes.

Name: Chicken Noodle Soup
Preparation: Boil chicken breast in water until cooked, then shred it.
In a large pot, sauté chopped carrots, celery, and onion until soft.
Add chicken broth and bring to a boil, then add noodles and shredded chicken.
Simmer for 10 minutes, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.

Name: Chicken Wrap with Hummus
Preparation: Grill or pan-cook chicken breast until fully cooked, then slice into strips.
Spread hummus on the tortilla, add chicken, lettuce, sliced tomato, and cucumber.
Roll the tortilla tightly into a wrap and serve.

Name: Grilled Paneer Sandwich
Preparation: Slice paneer, tomato, and onion into thin pieces.
Spread green chutney on bread slices, layer paneer, tomato, and onion.
Butter the outer sides of the bread and grill in a sandwich maker or pan until golden brown.
Cut into halves and serve hot.

Name: Chicken Shawarma Wrap
Preparation: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices, then grill or cook until tender.
Spread garlic sauce on pita bread, add shredded chicken, lettuce, tomato, and cucumber.
Roll tightly into a wrap and serve.

Name: Grilled Fish with Mashed Potatoes
Preparation: Season fish fillet with salt, pepper, and olive oil, then grill for 3-4 minutes on each side.
Boil potatoes until soft, then mash with butter, milk, salt, and pepper.
Serve grilled fish alongside mashed potatoes.

Name: Chicken Fried Rice
Preparation: Dice chicken breast and cook in a pan with oil until fully cooked.
Add chopped carrots, peas, and onion to the pan and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add cooked rice and soy sauce, mix well, and stir-fry for another 2 minutes before serving.

Name: Turkey Club Sandwich
Preparation: Cook bacon until crispy and set aside.
Toast bread slices, then spread mayonnaise on each slice.
Layer turkey, bacon, lettuce, and tomato between three slices of bread to form a club sandwich.
Cut into quarters and serve.

Name: Shepherd's Pie
Preparation: Cook ground lamb with chopped onion, carrots, and peas until browned.
Boil potatoes, then mash with butter and milk.
Layer the lamb mixture in a baking dish, top with mashed potatoes, and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.

Name: Shrimp Pasta
Preparation: Boil spaghetti until al dente, then drain.
Sauté garlic in olive oil, add shrimp, and cook until pink.
Add tomato sauce, mix in cooked spaghetti, and toss to coat.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese before serving.

Name: BBQ Chicken Wings
Preparation: Season chicken wings with salt, pepper, and olive oil.
Grill or bake wings at 200°C for 20-25 minutes until crispy.
Toss cooked wings in BBQ sauce and serve hot.

Name: Greek Salad with Grilled Chicken
Preparation: Season and grill the chicken breast until fully cooked, then slice.
Chop cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion into bite-sized pieces.
Combine vegetables with olives and crumbled feta in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano to make dressing.
Toss salad with dressing and top with grilled chicken.

Name: Lemon Chicken with Rice
Preparation: Marinate chicken thighs with lemon juice, garlic, olive oil, and thyme for 30 minutes.
Cook rice in chicken broth until tender.
Sear chicken thighs in a pan until golden, then bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25 minutes.
Serve chicken over rice with a drizzle of pan juices.

Name: Prawn Fried Rice
Preparation: Heat sesame oil in a wok and scramble the eggs, then set aside.
Sauté prawns until pink, then remove from wok.
Stir-fry carrots and peas in the wok for 3-4 minutes.
Add cooked rice, prawns, eggs, and green onions, then drizzle with soy sauce and stir well.

Name: Chicken Quesadilla
Preparation: Cook and shred chicken breast with cumin seasoning.
Sauté bell peppers and onions in olive oil until soft.
Place chicken, vegetables, and cheese on half of a tortilla, then fold.
Cook quesadilla in a skillet over medium heat until cheese melts and tortilla is golden.

Name: Stuffed Bell Pepper
Preparation: Cut tops off bell peppers and remove seeds.
Cook ground beef with onion and garlic until browned, then mix with rice and tomato sauce.
Stuff peppers with the mixture and top with cheese.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30 minutes until peppers are tender.

Name: Chicken Schnitzel with Coleslaw
Preparation: Pound chicken breast to thin cutlets, then coat in egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry chicken in vegetable oil until golden and cooked through.
Shred cabbage and carrots, then mix with mayonnaise for coleslaw.
Serve schnitzel with a side of coleslaw.

Name: Lentil and Mushroom Shepherd's Pie
Preparation: Boil and mash potatoes with butter.
Cook lentils in vegetable broth until tender.
Sauté mushrooms, carrots, and onion, then add tomato paste and lentils.
Layer lentil mixture in a baking dish, top with mashed potatoes, and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes.

Name: Caprese Zucchini Noodles
Preparation: Spiralize zucchini into noodles.
Halve cherry tomatoes and toss with zucchini noodles and mozzarella balls.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, then garnish with basil leaves.

Name: Quinoa Veggie Burger
Preparation: Cook quinoa and mash black beans.
Mix quinoa, beans, grated carrots, chopped onion, breadcrumbs, egg, and cumin to form patties.
Fry patties in a skillet until golden on both sides.
Serve patties in burger buns with desired toppings.

Name: Creamy Arborio Mushroom Risotto
Preparation: Sauté onion, garlic, and mushrooms in butter until soft.
Add Arborio rice and stir to coat, then gradually add vegetable broth, stirring constantly until absorbed.
Once rice is creamy and tender, stir in heavy cream and Parmesan cheese.
Serve hot with additional Parmesan if desired.

Name: Greek Chickpea Salad
Preparation: Rinse and drain chickpeas, then place in a large bowl.
Chop cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and red onion, and add to the bowl.
Crumble feta cheese over the salad.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano, then drizzle over the salad.
Toss everything to combine and serve chilled.

Name: Spinach & Ricotta Stuffed Shells
Preparation: Cook pasta shells according to package instructions, then drain and set aside.
In a bowl, mix ricotta, spinach, mozzarella, and garlic.
Stuff each shell with the ricotta mixture.
Spread marinara sauce in a baking dish, place stuffed shells on top, and cover with more sauce.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25 minutes or until bubbly.

Name: Veggie Pesto Wrap
Preparation: Spread pesto sauce evenly over the tortilla.
Layer bell peppers, zucchini, spinach, and feta cheese in the center.
Roll the tortilla tightly to form a wrap.
Cut in half and serve immediately.

Name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
Preparation: Melt butter in a pot and sauté onion until translucent.
Add broccoli and vegetable broth, bring to a boil, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and cheddar cheese until melted.
Blend the soup until smooth, if desired, and serve hot.

Name: Ratatouille
Preparation: Chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pan, sauté onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add eggplant, zucchini, bell pepper, and tomatoes, stirring occasionally.
Simmer for 30-40 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve warm.

Name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Bowl
Preparation: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss sweet potato cubes with olive oil and cumin, then roast for 25 minutes.
In a bowl, layer cooked brown rice, roasted sweet potato, and black beans.
Top with sliced avocado and serve.

Name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Wrap
Preparation: Grill chicken breast until fully cooked, then slice into strips.
Spread Caesar dressing over the tortilla.
Layer romaine lettuce, grilled chicken, and Parmesan cheese in the center.
Roll the tortilla tightly and serve.

Name: Baked Salmon with Asparagus
Preparation: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Place salmon and asparagus on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil, lemon juice, and sprinkle garlic over both.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until salmon flakes easily with a fork.
Serve hot.

Name: Chicken Alfredo Penne
Preparation: Cook penne pasta according to package instructions, then drain.
In a pan, cook chicken cubes until golden, then set aside.
In the same pan, melt butter and sauté garlic, then add heavy cream and Parmesan to make sauce.
Stir in cooked pasta and chicken, coating evenly in sauce.
Serve hot.

Name: Tuna & White Bean Salad
Preparation: In a large bowl, combine tuna, white beans, red onion, and parsley.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Toss gently to combine and serve chilled.

Name: Double Decker Turkey Club
Preparation: Toast three slices of bread.
Cook bacon until crispy.
Spread mayonnaise on one side of each bread slice.
Layer turkey, bacon, lettuce, and tomato on the first slice, top with the second slice, repeat layers, and top with the third slice.
Cut into quarters and secure with toothpicks.

Name: Beef Bolognese with Zoodles
Preparation: Spiralize zucchini into noodles (zoodles).
Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté chopped onion and garlic until soft.
Add ground beef, cook until browned.
Stir in tomato sauce, simmer for 15 minutes.
Lightly sauté zoodles for 2-3 minutes, then top with Bolognese sauce.

Name: Lemon Herb Chicken Quinoa
Preparation: Marinate chicken with lemon juice, olive oil, and herbs for 30 minutes.
Cook quinoa in water or broth until fluffy (about 15 minutes).
Grill or pan-sear chicken until fully cooked (about 6-8 minutes per side).
Serve chicken over a bed of quinoa, drizzle with extra lemon juice.

Name: Shrimp Scampi
Preparation: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
Melt butter in a pan, sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Add shrimp, cook until pink (about 2-3 minutes).
Deglaze with white wine, add lemon juice, and simmer for 2 minutes.
Toss shrimp and sauce with cooked spaghetti.

Name: Chicken & Mushroom Crepes
Preparation: Prepare crepe batter and cook thin crepes in a non-stick pan.
Sauté mushrooms and shredded chicken in butter until tender.
Add cream to the mixture, cook until thickened.
Spoon filling into crepes, fold or roll, and serve warm.

Name: Pork Schnitzel with Potato Salad
Preparation: Boil potatoes until tender, cool, and mix with mayonnaise for potato salad.
Pound pork cutlet thin, dredge in flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat with breadcrumbs.
Fry schnitzel in hot oil until golden brown on both sides (about 3-4 minutes per side).
Serve schnitzel with a side of potato salad.

Name: Mushroom Wellington
Preparation: Sauté chopped mushrooms, onion, and garlic in butter until soft, then cool.
Roll out puff pastry, place mushroom mixture in the center.
Fold pastry over the filling, seal edges, and brush with egg wash.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 25-30 minutes until golden brown.

Name: Spinach & Cheese Quiche
Preparation: Pre-bake pie crust at 180°C (350°F) for 10 minutes.
Sauté spinach until wilted, then cool.
Whisk eggs with cream, mix in spinach and shredded cheese.
Pour mixture into crust, bake for 30-35 minutes until set.

Name: Greek Spanakopita
Preparation: Sauté spinach and chopped onion in olive oil until soft, then cool.
Mix in crumbled feta cheese.
Layer phyllo dough in a baking dish, brushing each layer with olive oil.
Spread spinach mixture over phyllo, top with more phyllo layers, and bake at 180°C (350°F) for 30-40 minutes.

Name: Zucchini Fritters
Preparation: Grate zucchini, squeeze out excess moisture using a cloth.
Mix zucchini with flour, beaten egg, and minced garlic.
Form small patties from the mixture.
Heat olive oil in a pan, fry fritters until golden brown on both sides (about 3-4 minutes per side).

Name: Cauliflower Steaks
Preparation: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Cut cauliflower into 1-inch thick steaks.
Mix olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, and salt in a bowl.
Brush the mixture on both sides of the cauliflower steaks.
Place on a baking sheet and roast for 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and tender.

Name: Stuffed Eggplant (Imam Bayildi)
Preparation: Cut eggplants in half lengthwise and scoop out the flesh, leaving a shell.
Chop the flesh and sauté with onions, garlic, and tomatoes in olive oil.
Season with salt and parsley, then stuff the mixture back into the eggplant shells.
Place in a baking dish, drizzle with olive oil, and bake at 180°C (350°F) for 30-40 minutes.

Name: Broccoli Pesto Pasta
Preparation: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
Blanch broccoli in boiling water for 2-3 minutes, then drain.
Blend broccoli, basil, Parmesan, pine nuts, garlic, and olive oil into a pesto.
Toss the cooked pasta with the pesto and serve.

Name: Prawn Linguine
Preparation: Cook linguine according to package instructions.
Sauté garlic in olive oil, then add prawns and cook until pink.
Add cherry tomatoes and white wine, simmer for 5 minutes.
Toss with cooked linguine and garnish with parsley.

Name: Chicken Piccata
Preparation: Pound chicken breasts to an even thickness and dredge in flour.
Heat butter in a skillet and cook chicken until golden on both sides.
Remove chicken, then add lemon juice, capers, and white wine to the skillet to make a sauce.
Return chicken to the pan, coat with sauce, and serve.

Name: Pork Belly Bao
Preparation: Marinate pork belly in soy sauce and cook in the oven at 160°C (320°F) for 2-3 hours until tender.
Slice pork belly thinly.
Steam bao buns for 10 minutes.
Assemble buns with pork belly, hoisin sauce, cucumber, and spring onion.

Name: Fish and Chips
Preparation: Cut potatoes into chips and fry in hot oil until golden and crispy.
Make a batter with flour and beer, then coat the fish fillets.
Fry the battered fish in hot oil until golden and cooked through.
Serve fish and chips with a side of tartar sauce or vinegar.

Name: Swedish Meatballs
Preparation: Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, and egg, then form into small meatballs.
Fry meatballs in butter until browned on all sides.
Remove meatballs, then add beef stock and cream to the pan to make a sauce.
Return meatballs to the sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.

Name: Spanish Paella
Preparation: In a large pan, sauté chicken and chorizo until browned.
Add bell pepper and rice, stirring to coat in oil.
Add saffron and chicken stock, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook for another 5 minutes until rice is tender and shrimp is cooked.

Name: Croque Monsieur
Preparation: Make a béchamel sauce by melting butter, adding flour, and whisking in milk until thickened.
Layer ham and cheese between two slices of bread.
Spread béchamel sauce on top of the sandwich.
Grill or bake at 200°C (400°F) for 5-7 minutes until golden and bubbly.

Name: Veggie Shepherd's Pie
Preparation: Boil and mash potatoes with butter and milk.
Cook lentils with vegetable broth, carrots, peas, onion, and garlic until tender.
Layer the lentil mixture in a baking dish, top with mashed potatoes.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden on top.

Name: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
Preparation: Cook quinoa according to package instructions and let it cool.
Chop cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and red onion.
Mix quinoa with vegetables, feta, and olives in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, then toss to combine.

Name: Cacio e Pepe
Preparation: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain spaghetti.
In a pan, toast black pepper, then add reserved pasta water.
Add spaghetti and Pecorino Romano, stirring until a creamy sauce forms.

Name: Butternut Squash Soup
Preparation: Peel and cube butternut squash.
Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add squash and vegetable broth, simmer until squash is tender.
Blend until smooth, stir in cream, and season with salt.

Name: Caprese Zucchini Boats
Preparation: Halve zucchini lengthwise and scoop out the center to form boats.
Chop cherry tomatoes and mix with basil.
Fill zucchini boats with tomato mixture and top with mozzarella.
Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes, then drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.

Name: Stuffed Bell Peppers (Dinner Special)
Preparation: Cut tops off bell peppers and remove seeds.
Cook rice and set aside.
Sauté ground beef with onion and garlic, then mix with rice and tomato sauce.
Stuff peppers with mixture, top with cheese, and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes.

Name: Tomato Basil Bruschetta (Meal Size)
Preparation: Slice baguette and toast until golden.
Dice tomatoes and mix with chopped basil, garlic, olive oil, and balsamic vinegar.
Spoon tomato mixture onto toasted baguette slices.

Name: Chicken Alfredo
Preparation: Cook fettuccine according to package instructions.
Cook chicken breast in a pan until golden, then slice.
In the same pan, melt butter, add garlic, then stir in cream and Parmesan until thickened.
Toss pasta and chicken in the sauce.

Name: Lemon Garlic Butter Salmon
Preparation: Season salmon with salt.
Melt butter in a pan, add garlic, lemon juice, and zest.
Place salmon in the pan, cook for 3-4 minutes per side, basting with the sauce.

Name: Chicken Cacciatore
Preparation: Season and brown chicken thighs in olive oil, then set aside.
Sauté onion, bell pepper, and garlic in the same pan.
Add canned tomatoes, red wine, and oregano, then return chicken to the pan.
Simmer for 30-40 minutes until chicken is tender.

Name: Pasta Primavera (Dinner Special) (Variation 2)
Preparation: Cook pasta in boiling salted water until al dente, then drain.
Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté garlic, zucchini, and bell peppers for 5 minutes.
Add cherry tomatoes and cook for another 2 minutes.
Toss the cooked pasta with the vegetables, top with Parmesan and fresh basil.

Name: Nicoise Salad (Dinner Special)
Preparation: Boil potatoes and green beans until tender, then cool.
Arrange mixed greens on a plate, top with tuna, potatoes, green beans, eggs, and olives.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.

Name: Pork Belly Banh Mi (Fusion)
Preparation: Slow-cook pork belly with soy sauce until tender, then slice thinly.
Slice baguette lengthwise, spread mayonnaise on both sides.
Layer pork belly, pickled carrots, cucumber, and cilantro inside the baguette.

Name: Italian Lamb Chops
Preparation: Marinate lamb chops with olive oil, garlic, rosemary, lemon juice, and salt for 30 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear lamb chops for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Mediterranean Caprese
Preparation: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into even rounds.
Layer tomato and mozzarella slices alternately on a plate, adding basil leaves between layers.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar before serving.

Name: Rustic Chicken Alfredo
Preparation: Cook fettuccine in boiling salted water until al dente, then drain.
Cook chicken breast in a pan until golden, then slice.
In the same pan, melt butter, sauté garlic, add cream, and stir in Parmesan until thickened.
Toss pasta and chicken in the sauce and serve.

Name: Mediterranean Baked Salmon
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Place salmon in a baking dish, drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, and top with garlic and dill.
Add cherry tomatoes around the salmon and bake for 15-20 minutes until salmon flakes easily.

Name: Italian Grilled Chicken
Preparation: Marinate chicken with olive oil, garlic, Italian seasoning, and lemon juice for 30 minutes.
Grill chicken over medium heat for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Mediterranean Meatballs
Preparation: Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic, and parsley in a bowl, then form into meatballs.
Heat olive oil in a pan and cook meatballs over medium heat until browned on all sides.
Serve with a side of tzatziki or marinara sauce.

Name: Rustic Salad
Preparation: Chop tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion into bite-sized pieces.
Toss mixed greens with vegetables in a large bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, then season with salt and pepper.

Name: Seafood Paella
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a large pan, sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add tomatoes and saffron, cook for 5 minutes, then add rice and stir.
Pour in broth, bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Add seafood, cook until rice is tender and seafood is cooked through.

Name: Spaghetti Carbonara
Preparation: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Fry pancetta with garlic until crispy, then discard garlic.
Whisk eggs with cheese and pepper, then mix with hot pasta and pancetta off the heat.

Name: Tuna Nicoise Salad
Preparation: Boil potatoes and green beans until tender, then cool.
Arrange tuna, eggs, vegetables, and olives on a plate.
Whisk olive oil with mustard for dressing and drizzle over salad.

Name: Creamy Tuscan Chicken
Preparation: Season and sear chicken in olive oil until golden, then set aside.
Sauté garlic, add cream, cheese, spinach, and tomatoes, simmer until thickened.
Return chicken to pan, cook until fully done and coated in sauce.

Name: Pork Belly with Apples
Preparation: Score pork belly skin, season, and sear in hot oil until crispy.
Add onions, garlic, apples, and thyme to a baking dish with pork on top.
Roast at 350°F (175°C) for 2 hours until tender.

Name: Vegetable Lasagna (Dinner Special)
Preparation: Grill or roast zucchini and eggplant slices until tender.
Layer lasagna sheets, vegetables, ricotta, and tomato sauce in a baking dish.
Top with mozzarella and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30 minutes until bubbly.

Name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
Preparation: Toss chopped lettuce, chicken, cheese, and dressing in a bowl.
Place mixture in the center of the tortilla.
Fold and roll tightly to secure the wrap.

Name: Caprese Sandwich (Dinner Special)
Preparation: Slice ciabatta in half and drizzle with olive oil.
Layer mozzarella, tomato slices, and basil on the bottom half.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze, top with other half of bread, and press lightly.

Name: Tuna Salad Sandwich
Preparation: Mix tuna with mayonnaise and chopped celery in a bowl.
Spread mixture on one slice of bread, add lettuce.
Top with another slice of bread and cut in half if desired.

Name: Mushroom Risotto (Dinner Special) (Variation 2)
Preparation: Sauté onion and garlic in butter until soft, add mushrooms and cook until tender.
Stir in rice, cook for 2 minutes, then deglaze with white wine.
Add broth gradually, stirring until absorbed and rice is creamy, about 20 minutes.
Finish with Parmesan cheese and a knob of butter, stir until melted.

Name: Mediterranean Lamb Chops
Preparation: Marinate lamb chops with olive oil, garlic, rosemary, and lemon juice for 1 hour.
Grill or pan-sear the chops for 3-4 minutes on each side for medium doneness.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: French Grilled Chicken
Preparation: Mix Dijon mustard, olive oil, thyme, and garlic to make a marinade.
Coat chicken breast with marinade and let sit for 30 minutes.
Grill chicken for 5-6 minutes on each side until fully cooked.

Name: Spanish Ratatouille
Preparation: Chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pan, sauté onion until translucent.
Add remaining vegetables, cook on low heat for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Name: Hearty Baked Salmon
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Place salmon on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and top with garlic, dill, and lemon slices.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until salmon flakes easily with a fork.

Name: Oven-baked Salad
Preparation: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Cube sweet potato, toss with olive oil, and bake for 20 minutes.
Mix baked sweet potato with greens, cherry tomatoes, and feta. Drizzle with remaining olive oil.

Name: Alpine Chicken Alfredo
Preparation: Cook fettuccine pasta according to package instructions.
In a pan, cook chicken breast until golden, then slice.
In the same pan, melt butter, add cream and Parmesan, stir until thickened. Toss in pasta and chicken.

Name: Hearty Caprese
Preparation: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into even rounds.
Layer tomato, mozzarella, and basil leaves alternately on a plate.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar before serving.

Name: Spanish Minestrone
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a pot, sauté chopped carrots and zucchini.
Add tomato paste and vegetable broth, bring to a boil.
Add beans, simmer for 20 minutes until vegetables are tender.

Name: Oven-baked Grilled Chicken
Preparation: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Rub chicken thighs with olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, and salt.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).

Name: French Gnocchi
Preparation: Cook gnocchi in boiling salted water until they float to the surface, then drain.
In a pan, melt butter with garlic and sage until fragrant.
Toss gnocchi in the butter sauce, sprinkle with Parmesan before serving.

Name: French Roast Chicken
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Rub the chicken with olive oil, garlic, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Squeeze lemon juice over it and place lemon halves inside the cavity.
Roast in the oven for 1.5-2 hours, basting occasionally, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
Let rest for 10 minutes before carving.

Name: French Steak
Preparation: Season the steak with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat, add butter, garlic, and thyme.
Sear the steak for 3-4 minutes on each side for medium-rare, basting with the butter mixture.
Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

Name: Rustic Ratatouille
Preparation: Chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pot, sauté onion and garlic until translucent.
Add remaining vegetables, thyme, and salt. Cook over medium heat for 30-40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender.

Name: Spanish Grilled Chicken
Preparation: Marinate chicken thighs with olive oil, paprika, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and pepper for at least 1 hour.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Grill chicken for 5-7 minutes per side until fully cooked (internal temperature 165°F/74°C).
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Tuscan Beef Stew
Preparation: Cut beef into cubes and season with salt.
Heat olive oil in a pot, brown the beef on all sides, then remove.
Sauté onion, carrots, and celery in the same pot. Add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Deglaze with red wine, add beef broth and rosemary. Return beef to the pot.
Simmer on low heat for 2-3 hours until tender.

Name: Rustic Pasta
Preparation: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain.
Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté garlic until fragrant, then add chopped tomatoes. Cook for 10 minutes.
Toss pasta with the tomato sauce, top with fresh basil and grated Parmesan.

Name: Tuscan Gnocchi
Preparation: Cook gnocchi in boiling salted water until they float, then drain.
In a pan, melt butter and sauté garlic. Add heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until thickened.
Add spinach and cooked gnocchi to the sauce, tossing to coat. Season with salt.

Name: Greek Meatballs
Preparation: Mix ground meat with finely chopped onion, garlic, breadcrumbs, egg, oregano, mint, and salt.
Form into small meatballs.
Heat olive oil in a skillet and fry meatballs until browned on all sides and cooked through (about 10 minutes).
Serve with tzatziki or a yogurt dip.

Name: French Lamb Chops
Preparation: Marinate lamb chops with garlic, rosemary, olive oil, salt, and pepper for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a skillet or grill pan over high heat.
Sear lamb chops for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Modern Meatballs
Preparation: Combine ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, Parmesan, garlic, parsley, and salt in a bowl.
Form mixture into small meatballs.
Heat olive oil in a skillet and cook meatballs over medium heat for 8-10 minutes, turning to brown all sides.
Serve with marinara sauce or as desired.

Name: Classic Ravioli
Preparation: Boil water in a large pot, add a pinch of salt, and cook ravioli according to package instructions until al dente.
In a separate pan, heat olive oil and sauté minced garlic until fragrant, then add tomato sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
Drain ravioli, mix with the tomato sauce, and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese before serving.

Name: Classic Ratatouille
Preparation: Chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pan, sauté garlic and onion until translucent.
Add the remaining vegetables, season with salt and pepper, and cook on low heat for 30-40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender.

Name: Mediterranean Turkey Breast
Preparation: Marinate turkey breast with olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, and salt for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or oven to 180°C (350°F).
Grill or bake the turkey breast for 20-25 minutes, turning occasionally, until fully cooked and golden.

Name: Modern Chicken Alfredo
Preparation: Cook fettuccine pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain.
In a pan, melt butter and sauté minced garlic, then add heavy cream and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add Parmesan cheese to the sauce, stir until melted, then mix in cooked pasta and sliced grilled chicken breast.

Name: Gourmet Quiche
Preparation: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F) and place pie crust in a pie dish.
Whisk eggs with heavy cream, then mix in chopped spinach, cooked bacon, and shredded cheese.
Pour the mixture into the pie crust and bake for 35-40 minutes until set and golden.

Name: Gourmet Roast Chicken
Preparation: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
Rub the chicken with olive oil, minced garlic, rosemary, salt, and lemon juice, then stuff the cavity with lemon halves.
Roast the chicken for 1.5-2 hours, basting occasionally, until the internal temperature reaches 75°C (165°F).

Name: Greek Lasagna
Preparation: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
Cook ground lamb with olive oil and tomato sauce, season with salt and pepper.
Layer lasagna sheets, lamb mixture, sliced eggplant, and crumbled feta in a baking dish, repeating until full, then bake for 40 minutes.

Name: Spanish Lasagna
Preparation: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
Cook ground beef and sliced chorizo with olive oil and tomato sauce, season with salt and pepper.
Layer lasagna sheets, beef mixture, and shredded Manchego cheese in a baking dish, repeating until full, then bake for 40 minutes.

Name: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
Preparation: Whisk eggs with milk and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Heat butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat, pour in the egg mixture, and stir gently until softly scrambled.
Toast the bread, then top with scrambled eggs and serve immediately.

Name: Oats Porridge with Banana
Preparation: In a small pot, combine oats and milk, then cook over medium heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Slice the banana and add it to the porridge.
Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with cinnamon before serving.

Name: Continental Sausage Hash
Preparation: Dice potatoes, onion, and bell pepper into small cubes.
Heat olive oil in a skillet, add sausages and cook until browned, then remove and slice.
In the same skillet, add potatoes, onion, and bell pepper, cooking until potatoes are golden and tender.
Return sausages to the skillet, mix well, and cook for another 2-3 minutes.

Name: Eggs Florentine
Preparation: Sauté spinach in butter until wilted, season with salt and pepper.
Poach eggs in simmering water for 3-4 minutes until whites are set.
Toast English muffin halves, top with spinach, a poached egg, and drizzle with hollandaise sauce.

Name: Banana Walnut Pancakes
Preparation: Prepare pancake batter by mixing pancake mix with milk until smooth.
Slice banana and chop walnuts, then fold into the batter.
Heat butter in a skillet, pour batter to form pancakes, and cook until golden on both sides.

Name: Cottage Cheese with Pineapple
Preparation: Scoop cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with pineapple chunks and serve chilled.

Name: Spanish Lamb Chops
Preparation: Marinate lamb chops with olive oil, minced garlic, paprika, and rosemary for 30 minutes.
Heat a grill pan or skillet, sear lamb chops for 3-4 minutes per side for medium doneness.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Mediterranean Shrimp Scampi
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a skillet, add minced garlic, and sauté until fragrant.
Add shrimp, cook until pink, then deglaze with white wine and lemon juice.
Simmer for 2-3 minutes until sauce thickens slightly, then serve with pasta or bread.

Name: Mediterranean Risotto
Preparation: Sauté finely chopped onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add Arborio rice, stirring to coat, then gradually add warm vegetable broth, stirring until absorbed.
Once rice is creamy and tender, stir in chopped olives and crumble feta cheese on top before serving.

Name: Spanish Roast Chicken
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Rub chicken with olive oil, minced garlic, paprika, salt, and pepper, then stuff with lemon halves.
Roast for 1.5-2 hours, basting occasionally, until internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).

Name: French Minestrone
Preparation: Chop carrots and zucchini into small pieces.
In a pot, bring vegetable broth to a boil, add vegetables, beans, and pasta, then simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper, and herbs like thyme before serving.

Name: Mediterranean Beef Stew
Preparation: Brown beef chunks in a pot with olive oil, then remove and set aside.
Sauté chopped onion and garlic until soft, add diced tomatoes and red wine, then return beef to the pot.
Simmer on low heat for 2-3 hours until beef is tender, season with salt, pepper, and Mediterranean herbs.

Name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
Preparation: Toast the bread slices until golden and crisp.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper, then spread it on the toast.
Poach the egg in simmering water for 3-4 minutes until the white is set but yolk is runny.
Place the poached egg on top of the avocado toast and season with additional salt and pepper if desired.

Name: Shakshuka
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a skillet, sauté chopped onion and bell pepper until soft.
Add minced garlic, cumin, and paprika, cook for 1 minute.
Pour in canned tomatoes, simmer for 10 minutes until thickened, season with salt.
Make wells in the sauce and crack eggs into them, cover and cook for 5-8 minutes until eggs are set.

Name: French Toast with Maple Syrup
Preparation: Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, and cinnamon in a bowl.
Dip bread slices into the egg mixture, coating both sides.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat, cook bread slices for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Serve hot with a drizzle of maple syrup.

Name: Overnight Oats with Chia and Berries
Preparation: Combine oats, milk, chia seeds, and honey in a jar or bowl.
Stir well, cover, and refrigerate overnight or for at least 4 hours.
In the morning, top with fresh berries before serving.
image_path: data/final_images\Overnight Oats with Chia and Berries.jpg

Name: Hash Brown Skillet
Preparation: Shred potatoes and squeeze out excess moisture using a clean towel.
Heat butter in a skillet, add shredded potatoes and diced onion, season with salt and pepper.
Cook over medium heat for 5-7 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Fry eggs separately and serve on top of the hash browns.

Name: Classic Eggs Benedict
Preparation: Toast English muffin halves and top each with a slice of Canadian bacon.
Poach eggs in simmering water for 3-4 minutes.
Prepare Hollandaise sauce by whisking egg yolks, lemon juice, and melted butter over a double boiler until thickened.
Place poached eggs on bacon, drizzle with Hollandaise sauce, and season with salt.

Name: Smoked Salmon Bagel
Preparation: Slice and toast the bagel.
Spread cream cheese on both halves of the bagel.
Layer smoked salmon, thinly sliced red onion, capers, and a sprinkle of dill on top.

Name: Full English Breakfast
Preparation: Fry bacon and sausages in a skillet until crispy and cooked through.
Grill or fry halved tomatoes and mushrooms until tender.
Fry eggs to desired doneness (sunny-side up or over-easy).
Toast bread and butter it, then serve all components together on a plate.

Name: Steak and Eggs
Preparation: Season steak with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in a skillet over high heat, sear steak for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare (adjust for desired doneness).
Remove steak to rest, then fry eggs in the same skillet to desired doneness.
Serve steak and eggs together on a plate.

Name: Breakfast Burrito
Preparation: Cook sausage or bacon in a skillet until crispy, then set aside.
Fry diced potatoes in the same skillet until golden and tender.
Scramble eggs with butter in the skillet, then mix in cooked sausage/bacon and potatoes.
Lay tortilla flat, add egg mixture, cheese, and salsa, then roll tightly into a burrito.

Name: Alpine Minestrone
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped carrots, celery, and zucchini, and sauté for 5 minutes.
Stir in diced tomatoes and vegetable broth, bring to a boil.
Add pasta and cannellini beans, simmer for 10-15 minutes until pasta is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste before serving.

Name: Tuscan Grilled Chicken
Preparation: Marinate chicken breast with olive oil, minced garlic, rosemary, and lemon juice for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Grill chicken for 6-8 minutes per side until fully cooked.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Italian Salad
Preparation: Chop lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion into bite-sized pieces.
Toss vegetables with olives in a large bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, then toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste before serving.

Name: Mediterranean Gnocchi
Preparation: Cook gnocchi according to package instructions, then drain.
Heat olive oil in a pan, add minced garlic, and sauté for 1 minute.
Add halved cherry tomatoes and spinach, cook until spinach wilts.
Toss in cooked gnocchi and crumble feta cheese on top.
Stir for 2 minutes over low heat before serving.

Name: Greek Caprese
Preparation: Slice tomatoes and cucumber into thin rounds.
Layer tomatoes, cucumber, and feta cheese on a plate.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle oregano on top.
Season with salt and pepper to taste before serving.

Name: Mediterranean Minestrone
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped carrots and zucchini, sauté for 5 minutes.
Stir in diced tomatoes and vegetable broth, bring to a boil.
Add pasta and chickpeas, simmer for 10-15 minutes until pasta is tender.
Season with salt, pepper, and herbs before serving.

Name: French Chicken Alfredo
Preparation: Cook fettuccine pasta according to package instructions, then drain.
Season and cook chicken breast in a pan until fully cooked, then slice.
In the same pan, melt butter and sauté minced garlic for 1 minute.
Add heavy cream and parmesan cheese, stir until sauce thickens.
Toss pasta and chicken in the sauce, serve hot.

Name: Italian Caprese
Preparation: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into thin rounds.
Layer tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil leaves on a plate.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper to taste before serving.

Name: Greek Margherita Pizza
Preparation: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F).
Roll out pizza dough on a baking sheet.
Spread tomato sauce over the dough, then sprinkle feta cheese and olives.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle oregano on top.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden and cheese is melted.

Name: Greek Roast Chicken
Preparation: Marinate chicken thighs with olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, and oregano for at least 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Place chicken in a baking dish and roast for 35-40 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Italian Chicken Alfredo
Preparation: Cook fettuccine pasta according to package instructions, then drain.
Season and grill chicken breast until fully cooked, then slice.
In a pan, melt butter and sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Add heavy cream to the pan, bring to a simmer, and stir in Parmesan cheese until melted.
Toss cooked pasta and chicken in the sauce, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.

Name: Rustic Steak
Preparation: Season the steak with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over high heat.
Sear the steak for 3-4 minutes on each side for medium-rare, or to desired doneness.
Add garlic and rosemary to the pan during the last minute of cooking for extra flavor.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

Name: Smoked Salmon and Avocado Toast with Pumpkin Seeds
Preparation: Toast the whole grain bread slices until golden.
Mash avocado with a fork and mix with lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Spread the avocado mixture on the toast.
Top with smoked salmon slices and sprinkle pumpkin seeds over the top.
Serve immediately.
image_path: data/final_images\Smoked Salmon and Avocado Toast with Pumpkin Seeds.jpg

Name: Chia Seed Pudding with Almond Milk
Preparation: In a bowl, mix chia seeds with almond milk, honey, and vanilla extract.
Stir well to avoid clumps, then cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Stir again before serving, and top with fresh fruit or nuts if desired.

Name: Sweet Potato Hash
Preparation: Peel and dice the sweet potato into small cubes.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add diced sweet potato, bell pepper, and onion to the skillet.
Cook for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sweet potato is tender and slightly crispy.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve hot.

Name: Mushroom and Spinach Omelette
Preparation: Whisk eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Sauté sliced mushrooms until tender, then add spinach and cook until wilted.
Pour the whisked eggs over the vegetables and cook until set, about 2-3 minutes.
Fold the omelette in half and serve immediately.

Name: Oatmeal with Walnuts and Flaxseeds
Preparation: In a saucepan, combine rolled oats and milk over medium heat.
Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the oats are soft and creamy.
Remove from heat and stir in honey.
Top with walnuts and flaxseeds before serving.

Name: Tomato and Basil Bruschetta on Whole Grain
Preparation: Dice tomatoes and mix with chopped basil, olive oil, and a pinch of salt.
Toast whole grain bread slices until crispy.
Rub a garlic clove over the warm toast for flavor.
Spoon the tomato mixture over the toast and serve immediately.
image_path: data/final_images\Tomato and Basil Bruschetta on Whole Grain.webp

Name: Greek Yogurt Pancakes with Berries
Preparation: In a bowl, mix Greek yogurt, flour, eggs, and baking powder until smooth.
Heat butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour small amounts of batter into the skillet to form pancakes.
Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Serve with mixed berries and a drizzle of honey.

Name: Oven-Baked Tomatoes with Spinach
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cut tomatoes in half and place them cut-side up in a baking dish.
Sauté spinach with minced garlic in olive oil until wilted.
Spoon the spinach mixture over the tomatoes, season with salt and pepper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until tomatoes are soft, then serve warm.

Name: Smoothie with Kale and Apple
Preparation: Wash and chop kale and apple into smaller pieces.
Add kale, apple, banana, and almond milk to a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

Name: Scrambled Eggs with Bell Peppers
Preparation: Dice the bell peppers into small pieces.
Whisk the eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt.
Heat butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add bell peppers to the pan and sauté for 2-3 minutes.
Pour in the whisked eggs and stir continuously until cooked through.
Serve hot.

Name: Quinoa Porridge
Preparation: Rinse quinoa under cold water.
In a small pot, combine quinoa and almond milk, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until quinoa is soft.
Stir in honey and cinnamon, then serve warm.

Name: Avocado on Whole Wheat Toast
Preparation: Toast the whole wheat bread slices.
Mash the avocado in a bowl with lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Spread the avocado mixture on the toast and serve immediately.

Name: Oatmeal with Blueberries
Preparation: In a small pot, combine oats and milk, and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Once thickened, remove from heat and transfer to a bowl.
Top with blueberries and drizzle with honey before serving.

Name: Almond Flour Pancakes
Preparation: In a bowl, mix almond flour, eggs, almond milk, and baking powder until smooth.
Heat butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour small amounts of batter into the pan to form pancakes.
Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Serve with your favorite toppings.

Name: Almond Milk and Banana Smoothie
Preparation: Peel and chop the banana into smaller pieces.
Add banana, almond milk, and honey to a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

Name: Strawberry Yogurt Parfait
Preparation: Wash and slice the strawberries.
In a glass or bowl, layer Greek yogurt, strawberries, and granola.
Drizzle honey on top and serve immediately.

Name: Scrambled Eggs with Spinach
Preparation: Wash and roughly chop the spinach.
Whisk the eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt.
Heat butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add spinach to the pan and sauté for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the whisked eggs and stir continuously until cooked through.
Serve hot.

Name: Berry Smoothie Bowl
Preparation: Add mixed berries, banana, Greek yogurt, and almond milk to a blender and blend until thick and smooth.
Pour the mixture into a bowl.
Top with granola and additional fresh berries if desired.
Serve immediately.

Name: Almond and Date Milkshake
Preparation: Soak almonds in water for 4-6 hours and peel them.
Blend almonds, dates, milk, and honey until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve chilled.

Name: Barley Porridge
Preparation: Rinse barley and cook in water until soft (about 30 minutes).
Add milk, sugar, and cinnamon to the cooked barley.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until creamy.
Serve warm.

Name: Mushroom Omelette
Preparation: Chop mushrooms and onions finely.
Beat eggs in a bowl with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in a pan, sauté mushrooms and onions until soft.
Pour in the egg mixture and cook on medium heat until set.
Fold and serve hot.

Name: Oatmeal with Almonds
Preparation: Cook oats in milk over medium heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Chop almonds and add them to the cooked oatmeal.
Drizzle honey on top and serve warm.

Name: Oats and Yogurt Smoothie
Preparation: Blend oats, yogurt, banana, milk, and honey until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

Name: Avocado Toast
Preparation: Toast the bread slices until golden.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread the avocado mixture on the toast and serve.

Name: Egg and Spinach Wrap
Preparation: Beat eggs and cook in a pan with butter to make a scramble.
Sauté spinach lightly in the same pan.
Place eggs and spinach on the tortilla, sprinkle cheese on top.
Roll the tortilla into a wrap and serve.

Name: Kale and Pineapple Smoothie
Preparation: Wash and chop kale leaves.
Blend kale, pineapple, banana, and coconut water until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve chilled.

Name: Chia Seed Pudding with Berries
Preparation: Mix chia seeds with milk and let it sit for 4-6 hours or overnight in the fridge.
Stir the mixture to break up any clumps.
Top with mixed berries and drizzle honey before serving.

Name: Egg White Omelette with Bell Peppers
Preparation: Chop bell peppers and onions finely.
Whisk egg whites with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté bell peppers and onions until soft.
Pour in egg whites and cook on medium heat until set.
Fold and serve hot.

Name: Egg White and Spinach Wrap
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add spinach and sauté until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Pour in egg whites and cook until set, stirring occasionally.
Place the mixture in the center of the tortilla and wrap it up.

Name: Grapefruit and Ginger Cooler
Preparation: Mix grapefruit juice, grated ginger, and honey in a glass.
Add ice cubes and stir well.
Serve chilled.

Name: Almond and Cashew Mix
Preparation: Combine almonds and cashews in a bowl.
Mix well and serve as a snack.

Name: Quinoa and Green Peas
Preparation: Cook quinoa in water according to package instructions.
Steam green peas until tender, about 5 minutes.
Mix quinoa and peas in a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt.

Name: Watermelon and Feta Salad
Preparation: Combine watermelon cubes and crumbled feta in a bowl.
Sprinkle chopped mint leaves on top.
Drizzle with lime juice and toss gently before serving.

Name: Egg White and Avocado Toast
Preparation: Toast the whole grain bread slices.
Scramble egg whites in a non-stick pan until cooked.
Mash avocado and spread it on the toast, then top with scrambled egg whites.

Name: Oat and Almond Milk Porridge
Preparation: Combine oats and almond milk in a saucepan over medium heat.
Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Remove from heat, drizzle with honey, and serve warm.

Name: Orange and Grapefruit Bowl
Preparation: Combine orange and grapefruit segments in a bowl.
Serve fresh as a fruit salad.

Name: Sweet Potato and Spinach Hash
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add diced sweet potato and cook for 10-12 minutes until tender.
Add spinach and cook for another 2 minutes until wilted, season with salt.

Name: Quinoa and Almond Porridge
Preparation: Cook quinoa in almond milk over medium heat for 10-15 minutes until soft.
Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Remove from heat, top with sliced almonds and drizzle with honey before serving.

Name: Walnut and Fig Mix
Preparation: Chop the dried figs into small pieces.
Mix the walnuts and chopped figs in a bowl.

Name: Papaya and Lemon Bowl
Preparation: Peel and cube the papaya into bite-sized pieces.
Drizzle lemon juice and honey over the papaya in a bowl.
Mix well and serve fresh.

Name: Beetroot and Apple Juice
Preparation: Peel and chop the beetroot and apple into small pieces.
Blend the beetroot and apple with water until smooth.
Strain the mixture if desired and serve chilled.

Name: Ash Gourd (Winter Melon) Juice
Preparation: Peel and chop the ash gourd into small pieces.
Blend the ash gourd with water until smooth.
Strain the juice, add honey if desired, and serve chilled.

Name: Pineapple and Turmeric Smoothie
Preparation: Peel and cube the pineapple.
Blend the pineapple, turmeric powder, and coconut milk until smooth.
Serve chilled.

Name: Carrot and Ginger Smoothie
Preparation: Peel and chop the carrots into small pieces.
Blend the carrots, grated ginger, and water or orange juice until smooth.
Strain if desired and serve chilled.

Name: Kiwi and Cucumber Smoothie
Preparation: Peel and chop the kiwi and cucumber.
Blend the kiwi, cucumber, and water or coconut water until smooth.
Serve chilled.

Name: Papaya and Lemon Juice
Preparation: Peel and chop the papaya into small pieces.
Blend the papaya with lemon juice and water until smooth.
Strain if desired and serve chilled.

Name: Boiled Eggs with Black Pepper
Preparation: Place the eggs in a saucepan and cover with water.
Bring the water to a boil and cook for 8-10 minutes.
Cool the eggs under running water, peel, and sprinkle with black pepper and salt.

Name: Spinach and Mushroom Omelette
Preparation: Beat the eggs in a bowl with salt and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Sauté the mushrooms and spinach for 2-3 minutes.
Pour the beaten eggs over the vegetables and cook until set, about 3-4 minutes.
Fold the omelette and serve hot.

Name: Strawberry and Spinach Smoothie
Preparation: Wash the strawberries and spinach thoroughly.
Peel the banana and cut it into chunks.
Add all ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

Name: Egg and Mushroom Bhurji
Preparation: Chop the mushrooms, onion, and tomato finely.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Sauté onions until translucent, then add tomatoes and mushrooms.
Beat the eggs in a bowl and pour them into the pan.
Stir continuously until the eggs are cooked and scrambled.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve hot.

Name: Oats and Almond Milk Porridge
Preparation: Combine oats and almond milk in a saucepan over medium heat.
Stir occasionally and cook for 5-7 minutes until the oats are soft.
Remove from heat, stir in honey and a pinch of cinnamon.
Serve warm in a bowl.

Name: Strawberry and Almond Smoothie
Preparation: Wash the strawberries thoroughly.
Peel the banana and cut it into chunks.
