Add strawberries, almonds, banana, and almond milk to a blender.
Blend until smooth and serve immediately.

Name: Boiled Egg Whites with Spinach
Preparation: Boil the eggs in water for 10-12 minutes.
Cool the eggs, peel them, and discard the yolks.
Wash and lightly sauté the spinach in a pan for 2-3 minutes.
Serve the boiled egg whites with sautéed spinach on the side.

Name: Oats and Egg White Omelet
Preparation: Beat the egg whites in a bowl and mix in the rolled oats.
Chop the spinach finely and add it to the mixture.
Heat oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour the mixture into the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side.
Serve hot.

Name: Peanut Butter and Banana on Whole Wheat
Preparation: Toast the whole wheat bread slices if desired.
Spread peanut butter evenly on one side of the bread.
Peel and slice the banana, then place the slices on top of the peanut butter.
Serve as an open-faced sandwich or cover with another slice of bread.
image_path: data/final_images\Peanut Butter and Banana on Whole Wheat.jpg

Name: Papaya and Yogurt Bowl
Preparation: Peel and cut the papaya into small cubes.
Place the papaya cubes in a bowl.
Add Greek yogurt on top of the papaya.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.

Name: Orange and Strawberry Bowl
Preparation: Peel the orange and separate it into segments.
Wash and slice the strawberries.
Combine the orange segments and strawberries in a bowl.
Garnish with fresh mint leaves and serve.

Name: Kiwi and Strawberry Salad
Preparation: Peel and slice the kiwi into thin rounds.
Wash and slice the strawberries.
Combine kiwi and strawberries in a bowl.
Drizzle with honey and lemon juice, then toss gently.
Serve fresh.

Name: Avocado Toast with Cherry Tomatoes
Preparation: Toast the whole grain bread until golden brown.
Mash the avocado in a bowl and spread it evenly on the toast.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and place them on top of the avocado.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle a pinch of salt.

Name: Almond Butter Oatmeal
Preparation: Combine oats and almond milk in a saucepan over medium heat.
Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until oats are soft.
Stir in almond butter and honey until well combined.
Top with sliced banana before serving.

Name: Papaya and Chia Seed Bowl
Preparation: Scoop out the seeds from the papaya and cut it into cubes.
Mix chia seeds with coconut milk and let it sit for 10 minutes to thicken.
Place papaya cubes in a bowl, top with chia mixture and granola.
Drizzle with honey before serving.

Name: Greek Yogurt with Walnuts
Preparation: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Chop walnuts roughly and sprinkle over the yogurt.
Drizzle with honey and dust with a pinch of cinnamon.

Name: Green Smoothie Bowl
Preparation: Blend spinach, banana, avocado, and almond milk until smooth.
Pour the smoothie into a bowl.
Sprinkle chia seeds on top for added texture.

Name: Quinoa Porridge with Pumpkin Seeds
Preparation: Rinse quinoa under cold water.
Combine quinoa and almond milk in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until quinoa is soft.
Stir in maple syrup and cinnamon, then top with pumpkin seeds.

Name: Berry and Flaxseed Parfait
Preparation: Layer Greek yogurt at the bottom of a glass or bowl.
Add a layer of mixed berries on top of the yogurt.
Sprinkle flaxseeds and granola over the berries.
Repeat layers if desired.

Name: Smoked Salmon on Rye Bread
Preparation: Toast the rye bread lightly.
Spread cream cheese evenly over the toast.
Layer smoked salmon on top of the cream cheese.
Sprinkle capers and drizzle with lemon juice.

Name: Sweet Potato Hash with Spinach
Preparation: Peel and dice the sweet potato into small cubes.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add diced onion and sweet potato, cooking for 10-12 minutes until tender.
Stir in spinach and cook for another 2 minutes until wilted. Season with salt.

Name: Cucumber and Tomato Sandwich
Preparation: Spread hummus on both slices of whole grain bread.
Slice cucumber and tomato thinly.
Layer cucumber, tomato, and lettuce on one slice of bread.
Top with the other slice of bread and cut in half if desired.

Name: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
Preparation: Peel and slice the banana.
Add banana, peanut butter, almond milk, and honey to a blender.
Blend until smooth and serve immediately.

Name: Carrot and Apple Juice with Oatmeal
Preparation: Peel and chop the carrots and apple.
Juice the carrots and apple, then mix with water.
Cook oats with water or milk separately.
Serve the juice with a side of cooked oatmeal.
image_path: data/final_images\Carrot and Apple Juice with Oatmeal.png

Name: Scrambled Tofu with Bell Peppers
Preparation: Crumble the tofu into a bowl.
Chop the bell peppers into small pieces.
Heat olive oil in a pan, add bell peppers, and sauté for 3 minutes.
Add crumbled tofu, turmeric, and salt, then cook for 5 minutes while stirring.

Name: Orange and Grapefruit Salad with Mint
Preparation: Peel and segment the orange and grapefruit.
Chop the mint leaves finely.
Mix the fruit segments in a bowl, drizzle with honey, and garnish with mint.
image_path: data/final_images\Orange and Grapefruit Salad with Mint.webp

Name: Multigrain Bread with Boiled Egg
Preparation: Boil the egg in water for 10 minutes, then peel.
Toast the multigrain bread slices.
Slice the boiled egg and place on the toast, sprinkle with salt and pepper.

Name: Kiwi and Strawberry Oat Bowl
Preparation: Cook oats with milk over medium heat until soft.
Peel and slice the kiwi, and slice the strawberries.
Top the cooked oats with kiwi, strawberries, and a drizzle of honey.

Name: Beetroot and Carrot Smoothie
Preparation: Peel and chop the beetroot, carrot, and apple.
Add all ingredients to a blender with water.
Blend until smooth and serve chilled.

Name: Chia Pudding with Almond Milk
Preparation: Mix chia seeds, almond milk, honey, and vanilla extract in a bowl.
Stir well and let it sit for at least 2 hours or overnight in the fridge.
Stir again before serving.

Name: Apple and Cinnamon Oatmeal
Preparation: Peel and chop the apple into small pieces.
Cook oats with milk over medium heat until soft.
Stir in chopped apple and cinnamon, cook for 2 more minutes, then drizzle with honey.

Name: Almond Butter on Multigrain Toast
Preparation: Toast the multigrain bread slices.
Spread almond butter evenly on the toast.
Serve immediately.

Name: Chia Seed Pudding with Almonds
Preparation: Mix chia seeds with almond milk in a bowl and stir well.
Let it sit for at least 2 hours or overnight in the refrigerator until it thickens.
Stir in honey and top with sliced almonds before serving.

Name: Walnut and Banana Smoothie
Preparation: Peel and slice the banana.
Blend banana, walnuts, almond milk, and honey in a blender until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

Name: Tofu and Spinach Wrap
Preparation: Crumble tofu and sauté in olive oil until lightly browned.
Add spinach and cook until wilted.
Place the mixture in the center of the tortilla, roll it up, and serve.

Name: Sweet Lime and Orange Smoothie
Preparation: Peel and segment the sweet lime and orange.
Blend the fruits with yogurt and honey until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve chilled.

Name: Peanut Butter and Apple Toast
Preparation: Toast the bread slice.
Spread peanut butter evenly on the toast.
Slice the apple thinly and arrange on top of the peanut butter.

Name: Green Smoothie (Spinach, Apple, Celery)
Preparation: Wash and chop the spinach, apple, and celery.
Blend all ingredients with water until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

Name: Watermelon and Mint Salad
Preparation: Cut watermelon into bite-sized cubes.
Chop mint leaves finely.
Toss watermelon with mint and lime juice in a bowl and serve chilled.

Name: Pumpkin Seed and Oats Porridge
Preparation: Cook oats with milk in a saucepan over medium heat until creamy.
Stir in pumpkin seeds and honey.
Serve warm in a bowl.

Name: Sweet Potato and Apple Mash
Preparation: Peel and boil sweet potato until soft.
Peel, core, and cook apple until tender.
Mash both together with butter and cinnamon until smooth.

Name: Fresh Fig and Walnut Oatmeal
Preparation: Cook oats with milk in a saucepan over medium heat until creamy.
Slice fresh figs and chop walnuts.
Top the oatmeal with figs and walnuts before serving.

Name: Avocado Toast on Sourdough
Preparation: Toast the sourdough bread slices until golden and crisp.
Mash the avocado in a bowl with lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Spread the avocado mixture on the toasted bread.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve immediately.

Name: Papaya and Chia Seed Smoothie Bowl
Preparation: Blend papaya, banana, and coconut milk until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a bowl.
Top with chia seeds and granola before serving.
image_path: data/final_images\Papaya and Chia Seed Smoothie Bowl.jpg

Name: Oatmeal with Berries and Almonds
Preparation: Cook oats with milk in a saucepan over medium heat until creamy.
Transfer to a bowl and top with mixed berries and almonds.
Drizzle with honey and serve warm.

Name: Spinach and Tofu Scramble
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Crumble tofu into the pan and add turmeric, salt, and pepper.
Stir in spinach and cook until wilted, about 3-5 minutes.
Serve hot as a breakfast scramble.

Name: Greek Yogurt with Walnuts and Honey
Preparation: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with walnuts and drizzle with honey.
Serve immediately as a snack or breakfast.
image_path: data/final_images\Greek Yogurt with Walnuts and Honey.jpg

Name: Soy Milk and Almond Protein Shake
Preparation: Add soy milk, almond butter, protein powder, and banana to a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass and serve chilled.
image_path: data/final_images\Soy Milk and Almond Protein Shake.jpg

Name: Mixed Fruit Salad with Orange Juice Dressing
Preparation: Chop mixed fruits into bite-sized pieces and place in a bowl.
Mix orange juice and honey to make a dressing.
Drizzle the dressing over the fruits and toss gently.
Garnish with mint leaves and serve fresh.
image_path: data/final_images\Mixed Fruit Salad with Orange Juice Dressing.jpg

Name: Quinoa and Black Bean Bowl
Preparation: Cook quinoa according to package instructions and let it cool.
In a bowl, mix quinoa, black beans, corn, and diced avocado.
Drizzle with lime juice and olive oil, then toss to combine.
Serve as a hearty meal or side dish.

Name: Papaya and Mango Smoothie
Preparation: Peel and chop papaya and mango into chunks.
Add the fruits, coconut water, and ice cubes to a blender.
Blend until smooth and pour into a glass.
Serve chilled.

Name: Cucumber and Mint Sandwiches
Preparation: Thinly slice the cucumber and set aside.
Spread cream cheese on each slice of bread.
Layer cucumber slices and mint leaves on half of the bread slices.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper, then top with another slice of bread.
Cut into halves or quarters and serve.

Name: Cucumber Mint Smoothie
Preparation: Peel and chop the cucumber into small pieces.
Add cucumber, mint leaves, Greek yogurt, honey, and water to a blender.
Blend until smooth and serve chilled.

Name: Chicken Bone Broth with Boiled Egg
Preparation: Place chicken bones, chopped carrot, and onion in a large pot with water.
Simmer for 6-8 hours, skimming off impurities.
Strain the broth and season with salt to taste.
Boil the egg for 8-10 minutes, peel, and serve with a bowl of hot broth.
image_path: data/final_images\Chicken Bone Broth with Boiled Egg.jpg

Name: Boiled Eggs with Guacamole
Preparation: Boil eggs for 8-10 minutes, then cool and peel.
Mash avocado in a bowl, mix with lime juice, diced tomato, and chopped cilantro.
Serve guacamole as a dip or topping for the boiled eggs.

Name: Salmon and Cream Cheese Roll-up
Preparation: Spread cream cheese evenly over the tortilla.
Layer smoked salmon on top and sprinkle with dill.
Roll up the tortilla tightly and slice into bite-sized pieces.

Name: Pomegranate and Yogurt Bowl
Preparation: Scoop Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with pomegranate seeds and drizzle with honey.
Serve immediately.

Name: Egg White and Vegetable Scramble
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add chopped spinach and bell pepper, sauté for 2-3 minutes.
Pour in egg whites and scramble until fully cooked, about 3-4 minutes.

Name: Sweet Potato and Pumpkin Mash
Preparation: Peel and chop sweet potato and pumpkin into small chunks.
Boil in water until soft, about 15-20 minutes.
Drain and mash with butter and salt until smooth.

Name: Mashed Avocado and Sprouts Salad
Preparation: Mash avocado in a bowl with lemon juice.
Mix in sprouts and drizzle with olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve.

Name: Almond Milk and Fig Smoothie
Preparation: Peel and chop the banana and figs.
Add almond milk, figs, banana, and honey to a blender.
Blend until smooth and serve immediately.

Name: Peanut Butter and Banana Wrap
Preparation: Spread peanut butter evenly over the tortilla.
Place a peeled banana in the center of the tortilla.
Roll up the tortilla tightly and slice into pieces if desired.

Name: Mixed Seed Granola with Almond Milk
Preparation: Preheat oven to 150°C (300°F). Mix oats, seeds, and honey in a bowl.
Spread the mixture on a baking tray and bake for 15-20 minutes until golden, stirring occasionally.
Let it cool, then serve with almond milk in a bowl.
image_path: data/final_images\Mixed Seed Granola with Almond Milk.jpg

Name: Pear and Spinach Smoothie
Preparation: Add pear, spinach, banana, and water or almond milk to a blender.
Blend until smooth and serve immediately.

Name: Avocado and Cucumber Wrap
Preparation: Spread mashed avocado on the tortilla.
Layer cucumber slices and lettuce leaves on top.
Roll the tortilla tightly and cut into halves if desired before serving.

Name: Orange and Ginger Oatmeal
Preparation: In a saucepan, combine oats, orange juice, water, and grated ginger.
Cook over medium heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until oats are soft.
Sweeten with honey and serve warm.

Name: Pumpkin and Carrot Soup
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a pot and sauté onion until translucent.
Add pumpkin and carrot, then pour in vegetable broth. Simmer for 20 minutes until vegetables are soft.
Blend the mixture until smooth, then serve hot.

Name: Papaya Bowl with Lemon Zest
Preparation: Place papaya cubes in a bowl.
Top with Greek yogurt and sprinkle lemon zest over it.
Serve immediately as a refreshing snack.

Name: Barley (Jau) Porridge
Preparation: Rinse barley and cook in milk or water over low heat for 30-40 minutes until soft.
Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. Add more liquid if needed.
Sweeten with honey, sprinkle cinnamon, and serve warm.

Name: Strawberry and Almond Smoothie Bowl
Preparation: Blend strawberries, banana, and almond milk until smooth but thick.
Pour into a bowl and top with sliced almonds.
Serve immediately with a spoon.

Name: Fruit Salad with Yogurt
Preparation: Chop mixed fruits into bite-sized pieces and place in a bowl.
Add Greek yogurt and drizzle honey on top.
Mix gently and serve chilled.

Name: Boiled Egg Salad
Preparation: Boil eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel, and slice them.
In a bowl, combine lettuce, cherry tomatoes, and sliced eggs.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, then toss gently before serving.

Name: Rustic Caprese
Preparation: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into thick slices.
Layer tomato and mozzarella slices alternately on a plate, adding basil leaves between layers.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, then sprinkle with salt.

Name: Rustic Quiche
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Place pie crust in a pie dish.
Whisk eggs and cream together, then mix in cheese, spinach, salt, and pepper.
Pour mixture into the pie crust and bake for 35-40 minutes until set and golden.

Name: Italian Minestrone
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a pot, sauté onion, carrots, and celery until soft.
Add zucchini, tomatoes, and broth. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add pasta and beans, cook until pasta is tender. Season to taste.

Name: Spanish Steak
Preparation: Rub steak with olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Heat a grill or skillet over high heat and sear steak for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

Name: French Ratatouille
Preparation: Chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pot, sauté onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add remaining vegetables and thyme, simmer for 30-40 minutes until tender.

Name: Spanish Meatballs
Preparation: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic, and paprika. Form into small balls.
Heat olive oil in a pan and brown meatballs on all sides.
Add tomato sauce, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until cooked through.

Name: Rustic Grilled Chicken
Preparation: Marinate chicken with olive oil, garlic, rosemary, salt, and pepper for 30 minutes.
Heat a grill or skillet and cook chicken for 5-6 minutes per side until fully cooked.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Rustic Lamb Chops
Preparation: Rub lamb chops with olive oil, garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Heat a skillet or grill over high heat and sear chops for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Alpine Grilled Chicken
Preparation: Marinate chicken with olive oil, garlic, sage, salt, and pepper for 30 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until fully cooked.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Alpine Steak
Preparation: Season steak with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet with butter, add garlic and thyme, then sear steak for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Baste with butter during cooking, then let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Boiled Eggs with Sunflower Seeds
Preparation: Place eggs in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
Once boiling, cover the pan and remove from heat. Let sit for 10-12 minutes.
Cool the eggs in an ice bath, peel them, and sprinkle sunflower seeds on top before serving.

Name: Celery Sticks with Almond Butter
Preparation: Wash and cut celery into sticks.
Spread almond butter into the groove of each celery stick and serve.

Name: Steamed Edamame Beans
Preparation: Rinse edamame beans under cold water.
Steam the beans in a steamer basket for 5-7 minutes until tender.
Sprinkle with a pinch of salt (optional) and serve warm.

Name: Carrot Sticks with Hummus
Preparation: Peel and cut carrots into sticks.
Serve with a side of hummus for dipping.

Name: Cucumber and Mint Cooler
Preparation: Peel and slice the cucumber thinly.
Add cucumber slices and mint leaves to a glass of water.
Add ice cubes and stir. Let it sit for 5 minutes before drinking.

Name: Celery and Green Apple Juice
Preparation: Wash and chop celery stalks and green apple into smaller pieces.
Blend or juice the ingredients together until smooth.
Strain if desired and serve chilled.

Name: Watermelon Salad with Mint
Preparation: Cut watermelon into bite-sized cubes.
Chop mint leaves finely and sprinkle over the watermelon.
Drizzle with lime juice and toss gently before serving.

Name: Cucumber and Carrot Salad
Preparation: Peel and slice cucumber and carrot into thin strips or rounds.
In a bowl, mix olive oil and lemon juice to make a dressing.
Toss the vegetables with the dressing and serve fresh.

Name: Green Tea with Lemon
Preparation: Boil water and pour it into a cup with green tea leaves or a tea bag.
Let it steep for 3-5 minutes, then remove the tea bag or strain the leaves.
Add lemon juice, stir, and serve hot.

Name: Fresh Pomegranate Juice
Preparation: Extract seeds from the pomegranate.
Blend the seeds in a blender until juiced.
Strain the juice to remove pulp and serve chilled.

Name: Sliced Mango with Chia Seeds
Preparation: Peel and slice the mango into bite-sized pieces.
Sprinkle chia seeds over the sliced mango and serve.

Name: Cucumber and Tomato Salad
Preparation: Chop the cucumber and tomato into small pieces.
Mix them in a bowl, drizzle with lemon juice, and sprinkle with salt.
Toss well and serve fresh.

Name: Green Tea and Lemon
Preparation: Boil water and steep green tea leaves for 3-5 minutes.
Strain the tea into a cup, add lemon juice, and stir well before serving.

Name: Papaya and Pumpkin Seed Salad
Preparation: Peel and cube the papaya into small pieces.
Toss the papaya with pumpkin seeds and drizzle with lime juice.
Mix well and serve.

Name: Tomato and Celery Juice
Preparation: Chop the tomatoes and celery into small pieces.
Blend them together until smooth, strain if desired.
Add a pinch of salt, stir, and serve chilled.

Name: Coconut Water and Lime
Preparation: Pour fresh coconut water into a glass.
Add lime juice, stir well, and serve chilled.

Name: Almonds and Pumpkin Seeds
Preparation: Measure out the almonds and pumpkin seeds.
Mix them together in a small bowl or container and serve as a snack.

Name: Citrus Salad (Orange and Grapefruit)
Preparation: Peel and segment the orange and grapefruit.
Arrange the segments in a bowl and drizzle with honey.
Toss gently and serve fresh.

Name: Cucumber and Pineapple Juice
Preparation: Peel and chop the cucumber and pineapple into small pieces.
Blend them with water until smooth, strain if desired.
Serve chilled in a glass.

Name: Almonds and Dried Figs (Anjeer)
Preparation: Measure out the almonds and dried figs.
Mix them together in a small bowl or container and serve as a snack.

Name: Papaya Bowl with Seeds
Preparation: Scoop out the papaya flesh and cut it into small cubes.
Place the papaya cubes in a bowl and sprinkle chia seeds and pumpkin seeds on top.
Drizzle honey over the mixture and serve fresh.

Name: Spinach and Apple Juice
Preparation: Wash the spinach and apple thoroughly.
Core the apple and cut it into chunks.
Blend the spinach, apple, lemon juice, and water until smooth.
Strain if desired and serve chilled.

Name: Carrot and Orange Juice
Preparation: Peel and chop the carrots into small pieces.
Peel the oranges and separate into segments.
Juice the carrots, oranges, and ginger together in a juicer.
Stir well and serve immediately.

Name: Coconut Milk and Pineapple Smoothie
Preparation: Peel and cube the pineapple and banana.
Add coconut milk, pineapple, banana, and ice cubes to a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass and serve chilled.

Name: Watermelon and Mint Juice
Preparation: Remove seeds from watermelon and cut into cubes.
Blend watermelon, mint leaves, and lemon juice until smooth.
Strain if desired and serve chilled.

Name: Cucumber and Celery Juice
Preparation: Wash and chop the cucumber and celery into small pieces.
Blend cucumber, celery, lemon juice, and water until smooth.
Strain if desired and serve fresh.

Name: Aloe Vera and Lemon Juice
Preparation: Extract fresh aloe vera gel from the leaf by cutting and scooping it out.
Blend the aloe vera gel with water, lemon juice, and honey (if using).
Strain if needed and serve chilled.

Name: Mixed Berries with Almonds
Preparation: Wash all the berries thoroughly.
Mix the berries in a bowl and top with sliced almonds.
Drizzle honey over the mixture and serve fresh.

Name: Kiwi and Apple Salad
Preparation: Peel and slice the kiwi, and core and cube the apple.
Mix the kiwi and apple in a bowl.
Add chopped mint leaves, lemon juice, and honey, then toss gently.
Serve fresh.

Name: Pomegranate and Beetroot Juice
Preparation: Peel and chop the beetroot into small pieces.
Extract seeds from the pomegranate.
Juice the pomegranate seeds and beetroot together in a juicer.
Add lemon juice, stir well, and serve immediately.

Name: French Pork Chops
Preparation: Season pork chops with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat, add garlic and thyme, then sear pork chops for 4-5 minutes on each side until golden brown and cooked through.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Spanish Pasta
Preparation: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain.
In a pan, heat olive oil, sauté garlic and chorizo, then add tomato sauce and paprika.
Toss cooked pasta in the sauce and serve hot.

Name: French Bruschetta
Preparation: Slice baguette into thin pieces and toast until crispy.
Dice tomatoes, mix with chopped basil, olive oil, minced garlic, and salt.
Spoon the tomato mixture onto the toasted baguette slices and serve.

Name: Rustic Meatballs
Preparation: Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, finely chopped onion, minced garlic, and salt in a bowl.
Form into small balls and fry in a skillet over medium heat until browned and cooked through.
Serve with your favorite sauce or gravy.

Name: Spanish Risotto
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté chopped onion and chorizo until fragrant.
Add Arborio rice and saffron, stirring to coat, then gradually add chicken broth, stirring constantly until absorbed and rice is creamy.
Serve hot.

Name: Greek Ratatouille
Preparation: Chop eggplant, zucchini, and tomatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pot, add vegetables, and cook until tender, seasoning with oregano.
Crumble feta cheese on top before serving.

Name: Alpine Salad
Preparation: Wash and dry mixed greens, then place in a large bowl.
Add sliced apple, cubed Gruyere cheese, and walnuts.
Drizzle with olive oil and vinegar, toss to combine, and serve.

Name: Italian Baked Salmon
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Place salmon fillet on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with minced garlic, Italian herbs, salt, and lemon juice.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until salmon flakes easily with a fork.

Name: Greek Yogurt Parfait with Mixed Berries and Walnuts
Preparation: In a glass or bowl, layer Greek yogurt, mixed berries, and walnuts.
Drizzle honey on top.
Serve immediately or chill for later.
image_path: data/final_images\Greek Yogurt Parfait with Mixed Berries and Walnuts.jpg

Name: Carrot and Cucumber Sticks with Hummus
Preparation: Peel and cut carrots and cucumber into sticks.
Arrange sticks on a plate with a bowl of hummus for dipping.
Serve fresh.
image_path: data/final_images\Carrot and Cucumber Sticks with Hummus.webp

Name: Fresh Orange Slices
Preparation: Peel the orange using a knife or by hand.
Slice the orange into even rounds or separate into segments.

Name: Kiwi Fruit
Preparation: Peel the kiwi using a spoon or a knife.
Slice the kiwi into rounds or cut into bite-sized pieces.

Name: Boiled Egg Whites
Preparation: Place eggs in a saucepan and cover with water.
Bring water to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cool the eggs under cold running water, peel, and discard the yolks.
Serve the egg whites.

Name: Carrot Sticks with Lemon
Preparation: Peel the carrots and cut them into sticks.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the carrot sticks before serving.

Name: Flaxseed Crackers
Preparation: Mix flaxseeds with water and a pinch of salt, let sit for 10 minutes to form a gel.
Spread the mixture thinly on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake at 150°C (300°F) for 40-50 minutes until crisp.
Break into pieces and let cool before serving.

Name: Pineapple Chunks
Preparation: Peel the pineapple and remove the core.
Cut the pineapple into bite-sized chunks.

Name: Grapefruit Half
Preparation: Cut the grapefruit in half.
Use a spoon to scoop out segments or eat directly from the skin.

Name: Pear Slices
Preparation: Wash the pear and remove the core if desired.
Slice the pear into thin wedges or bite-sized pieces.

Name: Pomegranate Seeds
Preparation: Cut the pomegranate in half and score the skin to separate sections.
Tap the back of the pomegranate with a spoon to release the seeds into a bowl.

Name: Papaya Slices
Preparation: Peel the papaya and scoop out the seeds.
Slice the papaya into wedges or bite-sized pieces.

Name: Carrot and Apple Salad
Preparation: Peel and grate the carrots and apples into a large bowl.
Add lemon juice, honey, and raisins, then mix well to combine.
Chill in the refrigerator for 15 minutes before serving.

Name: Watermelon and Mint Cooler
Preparation: Blend the watermelon cubes until smooth.
Strain the juice into a glass, add lime juice and mint leaves.
Add ice cubes and stir well before serving.

Name: Celery and Apple Juice
Preparation: Wash and chop the celery stalks and apples.
Juice them together in a juicer.
Serve immediately in a glass.

Name: Pomegranate and Mint Salad
Preparation: Combine pomegranate seeds and chopped mint leaves in a bowl.
Drizzle with lime juice and honey, then toss gently.
Serve chilled.

Name: Tomato and Ginger Juice
Preparation: Chop the tomatoes and ginger into small pieces.
Blend them together until smooth, then strain the juice.
Add lemon juice, stir, and serve fresh.

Name: Almonds and Walnuts
Preparation: Measure equal portions of almonds and walnuts.
Mix them together in a small bowl or container.
Serve as a snack.

Name: Papaya and Lime Salad
Preparation: Place cubed papaya in a bowl.
Drizzle with lime juice and honey, then sprinkle with chopped mint leaves.
Toss gently and serve immediately.

Name: Orange and Carrot Juice
Preparation: Peel and chop the oranges and carrots.
Juice them together in a juicer.
Pour into a glass and serve fresh.

Name: Coconut Water with Chia Seeds
Preparation: Pour coconut water into a glass.
Add chia seeds and stir well.
Let it sit for 10 minutes to allow chia seeds to swell, then serve.

Name: Apple and Beetroot Juice
Preparation: Wash, peel, and chop the apples and beetroot.
Juice them together in a juicer.
Serve immediately in a glass.

Name: Aloe Vera and Mint Juice
Preparation: Extract fresh aloe vera gel from the leaf.
Blend aloe vera gel, mint leaves, water, and honey until smooth.
Strain the mixture if desired and serve chilled.

Name: Strawberry and Almond Milk Shake
Preparation: Wash and hull the strawberries.
Blend strawberries, almond milk, and honey until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

Name: Pomegranate and Pear Salad
Preparation: Peel and dice the pear into small pieces.
Mix pomegranate seeds and diced pear in a bowl.
Drizzle with lemon juice and honey, then garnish with mint leaves.

Name: Lemon Water with Chia Seeds
Preparation: Squeeze fresh lemon juice into a glass of water.
Add chia seeds and stir well.
Let it sit for 5-10 minutes before drinking.

Name: Walnuts and Brazil Nuts Mix
Preparation: Measure equal quantities of walnuts and Brazil nuts.
Mix them together in a small bowl or container.
Serve as a snack.

Name: Orange and Pomegranate Bowl
Preparation: Peel and segment the orange into bite-sized pieces.
Mix orange segments with pomegranate seeds in a bowl.
Serve fresh.

Name: Cabbage and Apple Juice
Preparation: Wash and chop cabbage and apple into small pieces.
Blend cabbage, apple, water, and lemon juice until smooth.
Strain if desired and serve chilled.

Name: Watermelon Slices
Preparation: Cut watermelon into slices or cubes.
Remove seeds if desired.
Serve fresh and chilled.

Name: Green Apple and Cinnamon
Preparation: Wash and slice the green apple into thin pieces.
Sprinkle cinnamon powder over the apple slices.
Serve as a snack.

Name: Walnut and Almond Mix
Preparation: Measure equal quantities of walnuts and almonds.
Mix them together in a small bowl or container.
Serve as a snack.

Name: Strawberry Bowl
Preparation: Wash and hull the strawberries.
Place strawberries in a bowl and top with Greek yogurt.

Name: Pecan Nuts
Preparation: Measure out a serving of pecan nuts.
Serve as is or lightly toast in a pan for added flavor.

Name: Carrot and Beetroot Juice
Preparation: Peel and chop carrots and beetroot into small pieces.
Blend the vegetables with water until smooth.
Strain the mixture if desired and serve chilled.

Name: Hemp Seed Energy Bite
Preparation: Blend dates and almonds in a food processor until sticky.
Mix in hemp seeds and form into small balls.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving.

Name: Pomegranate and Mint Infusion
Preparation: Add pomegranate seeds and mint leaves to a glass or pitcher.
Pour in water and let it infuse for 1-2 hours in the refrigerator.
Serve chilled.

Name: Pistachios
Preparation: Measure out a serving of pistachios.
Serve as is or lightly roast for enhanced flavor.

Name: Warm Lemon Water
Preparation: Heat water to a warm, comfortable temperature.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice into the water and stir well.
Serve immediately.

Name: Pumpkin and Sunflower Seed Mix
Preparation: Measure equal parts of pumpkin and sunflower seeds.
Mix together and serve as a snack, or lightly toast if desired.

Name: Fresh Aloe Vera Water
Preparation: Extract fresh gel from an aloe vera leaf.
Blend the gel with water until fully mixed.
Serve chilled.

Name: Apple and Cinnamon Infused Water
Preparation: Slice an apple thinly and place in a glass or pitcher.
Add a cinnamon stick to the container.
Pour in water and let it infuse for 1-2 hours in the refrigerator.
Serve chilled.

Name: Pineapple and Mint Salad
Preparation: Dice the pineapple into bite-sized pieces and place in a bowl.
Add chopped mint leaves, lime juice, and honey. Toss well to combine.
Chill in the refrigerator for 15 minutes before serving.

Name: Papaya and Cucumber Cooler
Preparation: Blend papaya, cucumber, lime juice, and water until smooth.
Strain if desired for a smoother texture.
Pour into a glass over ice cubes and serve chilled.

Name: Orange and Spinach Juice
Preparation: Peel the oranges and separate into segments.
Blend oranges, spinach, and water until smooth.
Strain if desired and serve immediately.

Name: Cucumber and Lemon Water
Preparation: Slice the cucumber and lemon thinly.
Add them to a glass or pitcher with water and ice cubes.
Let it sit for 10 minutes to infuse flavors before drinking.

Name: Papaya and Pomegranate Bowl
Preparation: Cube the papaya and place in a bowl.
Add pomegranate seeds, lime juice, and honey. Mix gently.
Serve immediately or chill for 10 minutes.

Name: Soaked Black Raisins
Preparation: Place black raisins in a small bowl.
Add water and let them soak overnight or for at least 6 hours.
Drain excess water and consume.

Name: Kiwi and Cucumber Cooler
Preparation: Blend kiwi, cucumber, lime juice, and water until smooth.
Strain if desired for a smoother texture.
Pour into a glass over ice cubes and serve chilled.

Name: Toasted Pumpkin and Sunflower Seeds
Preparation: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add pumpkin and sunflower seeds, stirring constantly for 5-7 minutes until lightly toasted.
Sprinkle a pinch of salt, mix well, and let cool before serving.

Name: Almond and Pistachio Mix
Preparation: If using raw nuts, optionally toast them in a pan over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Mix almonds and pistachios in a bowl or small container.
Serve as a snack or store in an airtight container.

Name: Green Papaya Salad (Som Tum)
Preparation: Shred the green papaya using a grater or mandoline and place in a large bowl.
In a mortar and pestle, pound garlic and chili together to form a paste.
Add lime juice, fish sauce, and palm sugar to the paste, mixing until sugar dissolves.
Add green beans and cherry tomatoes to the mortar, lightly pound to bruise them.
Toss the shredded papaya with the dressing and other ingredients. Top with crushed peanuts before serving.

Name: Grapes Bowl
Preparation: Wash the grapes thoroughly under running water.
Place the grapes in a bowl and serve fresh.

Name: Dried Apricots
Preparation: Measure out the dried apricots.
Serve in a small bowl or as a snack on the go.

Name: Brazil Nut
Preparation: Measure out the Brazil nuts (approximately 5-6 nuts).
Serve as a snack or add to a small container for portability.

Name: Lemon and Ginger Water
Preparation: Boil or heat the water to a warm temperature.
Squeeze the juice of half a lemon into the water.
Grate or slice the ginger and add it to the water.
Let it steep for 5 minutes, then strain if desired before drinking.

Name: Hazelnut Portion
Preparation: Measure out the hazelnuts (approximately 20-25 nuts).
Serve in a small bowl or pack as a snack.

Name: Apple Slices with Peanut Butter
Preparation: Wash and core the apple, then slice it into wedges.
Spread peanut butter on each apple slice.
Arrange on a plate and serve immediately.

Name: Cashews
Preparation: Measure out the cashews (approximately 15-20 nuts).
Serve in a small bowl or as a portable snack.

Name: Celery Juice Shot
Preparation: Wash the celery stalks thoroughly.
Juice the celery using a juicer or blend and strain through a fine mesh.
Pour into a small glass and serve as a shot.

Name: Toasted Pumpkin and Sesame Seeds
Preparation: Heat a dry skillet over medium heat.
Add pumpkin seeds and sesame seeds, stirring frequently for 3-5 minutes until lightly toasted.
Let cool, then serve in a small bowl or store in an airtight container.

Name: Blackberry Bowl
Preparation: Wash the blackberries gently under running water.
Place in a bowl and serve fresh.

Name: Dragon Fruit Cubes
Preparation: Peel the dragon fruit and cut it into small cubes.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Name: Roasted Almonds
Preparation: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
Toss almonds with olive oil and salt.
Spread almonds on a baking sheet and roast for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Let cool before serving.

Name: Mint and Lime Infusion
Preparation: Add mint leaves and lime slices to a glass or pitcher.
Pour in water and let it infuse for at least 30 minutes in the refrigerator.
Serve chilled.

Name: Grapefruit Juice
Preparation: Peel the grapefruit and remove any seeds.
Juice the grapefruit using a manual or electric juicer.
Strain if desired and serve chilled.

Name: Chia Seed Pudding (Small Portion)
Preparation: Mix chia seeds with almond milk in a bowl or jar.
Stir in honey and mix well.
Let it sit in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours or overnight until it thickens.
Stir before serving.

Name: Sunflower Seed Butter on Crackers
Preparation: Spread sunflower seed butter evenly on the crackers.
Serve immediately.

Name: Walnut Halves
Preparation: Serve raw walnut halves as is, or lightly toast if desired.

Name: Lemon and Basil Infused Water
Preparation: Add lemon slices and basil leaves to a glass or pitcher.
Pour in water and let it infuse for at least 30 minutes in the refrigerator.
Serve chilled.

Name: Blueberries
Preparation: Rinse blueberries under cold water.
Serve fresh in a bowl.

Name: Roasted Flaxseeds and Pumpkin Seeds
Preparation: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
Toss flaxseeds and pumpkin seeds with olive oil and salt.
Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Let cool before serving.

Name: ABC Juice (Apple, Beetroot, Carrot)
Preparation: Wash and peel the apple, beetroot, and carrot.
Chop them into small pieces and blend them with water until smooth.
Strain the juice if desired and serve fresh.

Name: Cucumber and Mint Infused Water
Preparation: Slice the cucumber thinly.
Add cucumber slices and mint leaves to a glass or pitcher of water.
Let it infuse for 1-2 hours in the refrigerator before serving.

Name: Mixed Melon Salad (Watermelon, Muskmelon)
Preparation: Scoop out the flesh of both melons and cut into bite-sized cubes.
Mix the melon pieces in a bowl and serve chilled.

Name: Orange and Ginger Juice
Preparation: Peel the oranges and separate the segments.
Peel and grate the ginger.
Blend the orange segments and ginger with water, strain if desired, and serve.

Name: Papaya Bowl
Preparation: Cut the papaya in half and scoop out the seeds.
Peel the skin and cut the flesh into cubes or scoop out with a spoon.
Serve in a bowl.

Name: Pistachios (Unsalted)
Preparation: Measure out the pistachios.
Serve as a snack.

Name: Pineapple and Mint Juice
Preparation: Peel and chop the pineapple into small pieces.
Blend the pineapple and mint leaves with water until smooth.
Strain if desired and serve chilled.

Name: Hemp Seeds and Almond Milk
Preparation: Measure out the hemp seeds and almond milk.
Mix the hemp seeds into the almond milk and stir well.
Serve as a drink or with cereal.

Name: Sunflower Seeds
Preparation: Measure out the sunflower seeds.
Serve as a snack or sprinkle over salads.

Name: Green Apple and Spinach Juice
Preparation: Wash and chop the green apple and spinach.
Blend them with water until smooth.
Strain if desired and serve fresh.

Name: Soaked Walnuts and Dates
Preparation: Soak walnuts and dates in water overnight.
Drain the water before consuming.

Name: Orange and Ginger Shot
Preparation: Extract juice from fresh oranges.
Mix grated ginger into the orange juice and strain if desired.
Serve immediately in a small shot glass.

Name: Watermelon Cubes with Black Salt
Preparation: Cut watermelon into bite-sized cubes.
Sprinkle black salt over the cubes before serving.

Name: Carrot and Celery Sticks
Preparation: Peel and cut carrots into sticks.
Wash and cut celery into sticks.
Serve fresh as a snack.

Name: Mixed Nut Trail Mix
Preparation: Mix all the nuts and raisins in a bowl.
Store in an airtight container or serve immediately.

Name: Pumpkin Seeds and Raisins
Preparation: Mix pumpkin seeds and raisins together.
Serve as a snack or store in an airtight container.

Name: Strawberry and Chia Water
Preparation: Add sliced strawberries and chia seeds to a glass of water.
Let it sit for 10-15 minutes to allow chia seeds to swell.
Stir and drink.

Name: Grapefruit Wedges
Preparation: Peel the grapefruit and separate it into wedges.
Serve fresh.

Name: Beetroot and Lemon Juice
Preparation: Blend peeled beetroot with water until smooth.
Strain the juice if desired.
Add lemon juice, stir, and serve chilled.

Name: Oat Bran and Milk Drink
Preparation: Mix oat bran with milk in a glass or shaker.
Stir or shake well until fully combined.
Add honey for sweetness if desired and drink immediately.

Name: Aloe Vera and Lemon Water
Preparation: Extract fresh aloe vera gel from the leaf.
Mix aloe vera gel, lemon juice, and honey (if using) in a glass of water.
Stir well and serve chilled.

Name: Soaked Walnuts and Almonds
Preparation: Soak walnuts and almonds in water overnight (8-12 hours).
Drain the water and rinse before consuming.

Name: Black Raisins (Soaked) and Cashews
Preparation: Soak black raisins in water overnight (8-12 hours).
Drain the water from raisins and mix with cashews before consuming.

Name: Pomegranate Juice (Fresh, Unstrained)
Preparation: Extract seeds from a fresh pomegranate.
Blend the seeds in a blender until juiced.
Serve without straining for maximum fiber content.

Name: Aloe Vera and Lemon Shot
Preparation: Extract fresh aloe vera gel from the leaf.
Mix aloe vera gel with lemon juice in a small glass.
Stir and consume as a shot.

Name: Grapefruit Segments
Preparation: Peel the grapefruit and separate it into segments.
Remove any seeds or excess pith before serving.

Name: Tomato and Basil Juice
Preparation: Chop tomatoes into small pieces.
Blend tomatoes, basil leaves, and water until smooth.
Add a pinch of salt, stir, and serve fresh.

Name: Pistachios and Dried Figs
Preparation: Measure out pistachios and dried figs.
Mix together and consume as a snack.

Name: Grilled Salmon with Asparagus
Preparation: Season the salmon fillet with salt, pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil.
Trim the woody ends of the asparagus and toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Preheat a grill or grill pan over medium heat.
Grill the salmon for 3-4 minutes on each side until cooked through.
Grill asparagus for 2-3 minutes until tender-crisp.
Drizzle lemon juice over the salmon and asparagus before serving.

Name: Vegetable Fried Rice
Preparation: Heat vegetable oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add mixed vegetables and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Add cooked rice to the pan and mix well with the vegetables.
Pour soy sauce over the rice, season with salt and pepper, and stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Serve hot.

Name: Margherita Pita Pizza
Preparation: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Spread tomato sauce over pita bread, top with mozzarella and basil, then drizzle with olive oil.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.

Name: Gnocchi with Gorgonzola Cream Sauce
Preparation: Cook gnocchi in boiling salted water until they float to the surface, then drain.
In a saucepan, melt butter, add cream, and stir in Gorgonzola until melted into a smooth sauce.
Toss gnocchi in the sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan before serving.

Name: Mediterranean Couscous Salad
Preparation: Cook couscous according to package instructions and let it cool.
Chop tomatoes and cucumber, mix with couscous, olives, and crumbled feta.
Drizzle with olive oil and toss to combine.

Name: Vegetable Pot Pie
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cook vegetables and potatoes in butter, add broth, and simmer until thickened.
Place mixture in a pie dish, cover with pie crust, and bake for 30-35 minutes until golden.

Name: Steak and Mashed Potatoes
Preparation: Season steak with salt and pepper, then sear in a hot pan with olive oil for 3-4 minutes per side.
Boil potatoes until tender, mash with butter and milk until smooth.
Serve steak alongside mashed potatoes.

Name: Chicken Parmesan
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Coat chicken in breadcrumbs and Parmesan, then fry until golden.
Place in a baking dish, top with tomato sauce and mozzarella, and bake for 20 minutes.

Name: Lemon Butter Baked Cod
Preparation: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Melt butter with lemon juice and minced garlic, pour over cod in a baking dish.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, garnish with chopped parsley before serving.

Name: Pork Chops with Apple Chutney
Preparation: Season pork chops and sear in olive oil for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through.
Chop apples and cook with brown sugar and vinegar until soft to make chutney.
Serve pork chops topped with apple chutney.

Name: Spaghetti Bolognese
Preparation: Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water until al dente, then drain.
Sauté onion and garlic, add ground beef, and cook until browned.
Stir in tomato sauce, simmer for 15 minutes, and serve over spaghetti.

Name: Garlic Butter Shrimp with Zucchini
Preparation: Slice zucchini into thin rounds.
Melt butter in a pan, add minced garlic, then shrimp, and cook until pink (about 2-3 minutes).
Add zucchini and lemon juice, sauté for another 3-4 minutes, and serve.

Name: Mushroom Risotto
Preparation: Heat olive oil and butter in a pan, sauté chopped onion and garlic until translucent.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until softened.
Stir in Arborio rice, cook for 1-2 minutes, then gradually add vegetable broth, stirring constantly until absorbed.
Continue adding broth until rice is creamy and tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in Parmesan cheese and serve hot.

Name: Grilled Chicken Breast with Salad
Preparation: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper, then grill over medium heat for 6-8 minutes per side until cooked through.
Toss mixed greens, halved cherry tomatoes, and sliced cucumber with olive oil and lemon juice.
Slice grilled chicken and serve on top of the salad.

Name: Pasta Primavera
Preparation: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain.
In a large pan, heat olive oil and sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Add sliced zucchini, bell peppers, and broccoli, cooking until tender.
Toss in cooked pasta, season with salt, and top with Parmesan cheese before serving.

Name: Chicken Caesar Salad
Preparation: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper, then grill or pan-sear until cooked through, about 6-8 minutes per side.
Chop romaine lettuce and toss with Caesar dressing.
Slice chicken, add to salad along with croutons and shaved Parmesan, then serve.

Name: Vegetable Lasagna
Preparation: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions, then drain.
Sauté sliced zucchini and spinach in olive oil until tender.
Layer noodles, ricotta cheese, vegetables, and tomato sauce in a baking dish, repeating until full.
Top with mozzarella cheese and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30-40 minutes until bubbly and golden.

Name: Eggplant Parmesan
Preparation: Slice eggplant into rounds, dip in beaten egg, then coat with breadcrumbs.
Fry eggplant slices in olive oil until golden on both sides.
Layer fried eggplant, tomato sauce, and mozzarella in a baking dish, repeating until full.
Top with Parmesan cheese and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25-30 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.

Name: Mushroom Stroganoff
Preparation: Cook egg noodles in boiling water until tender, then drain.
In a pan, melt butter and sauté chopped onion and garlic until soft.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until browned, then stir in vegetable broth and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in sour cream, heat through, and serve over cooked noodles.

Name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
Preparation: Cut tops off bell peppers and remove seeds.
In a pan, heat olive oil and cook chopped onion and ground meat until browned.
Mix in cooked rice and half of the tomato sauce, then stuff mixture into bell peppers.
Place peppers in a baking dish, top with remaining tomato sauce and cheese, and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30 minutes.

Name: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup with Grilled Cheese
Preparation: In a pot, sauté chopped onion and garlic in butter until soft.
Add canned tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes, then blend until smooth.
Stir in heavy cream and chopped basil, heat through, and season to taste.
For grilled cheese, butter bread slices, add cheese between two slices, and grill in a pan until golden on both sides.
Serve soup with grilled cheese sandwich on the side.
image_path: data/final_images\Creamy Tomato Basil Soup with Grilled Cheese.webp

Name: Butternut Squash Risotto
Preparation: Peel and dice butternut squash, then roast at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes until tender.
Heat olive oil and butter in a pan, sauté chopped onion and garlic until translucent.
Stir in Arborio rice, cook for 1-2 minutes, then gradually add vegetable broth, stirring constantly until absorbed.
Add roasted squash halfway through, continue adding broth until rice is creamy and tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in Parmesan cheese and serve hot.

Name: Chicken Fajita Bowl
Preparation: Slice chicken breast, bell peppers, and onion into thin strips.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, add chicken and seasoning, and cook until browned.
Add peppers and onion, sauté until tender.
Serve over cooked rice in a bowl.

Name: Shepherd's Pie (Beef)
Preparation: Boil and mash potatoes with butter.
Cook ground beef with chopped onion, carrots, and peas in a skillet; add beef stock and simmer.
Transfer beef mixture to a baking dish, top with mashed potatoes.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes until golden.

Name: Baked Ziti with Sausage
Preparation: Cook ziti pasta according to package instructions.
Brown sausage in a skillet, then mix with marinara sauce.
Layer pasta, sausage mixture, and ricotta in a baking dish; top with mozzarella.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 25 minutes until bubbly and golden.

Name: Pan-Seared Duck Breast
Preparation: Score the skin of the duck breast and season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Place duck breast skin-side down and sear for 6-8 minutes until crispy, then flip and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

Name: Creamy Polenta with Mushrooms
Preparation: Cook polenta in vegetable stock according to package instructions, stirring in cream and butter at the end.
Sauté mushrooms and garlic in butter until tender.
Serve mushrooms over creamy polenta.

Name: Spinach and Feta Stuffed Portobello
Preparation: Remove stems from portobello mushrooms and brush with olive oil.
Sauté spinach and garlic until wilted, then mix with crumbled feta.
Stuff mushroom caps with spinach mixture.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 15-20 minutes.

Name: Pasta Primavera (Dinner Special)
Preparation: Cook penne pasta according to package instructions.
Sauté zucchini, bell peppers, and cherry tomatoes in olive oil until tender.
Toss vegetables with cooked pasta and top with Parmesan cheese.

Name: French Onion Soup
Preparation: Caramelize sliced onions in butter over low heat for 30-40 minutes.
Add beef stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls, top with baguette slices and Gruyere cheese.
Broil until cheese is melted and bubbly.

Name: Margarita Risotto
Preparation: Heat olive oil in a pan, add Arborio rice, and toast for 1-2 minutes.
Gradually add chicken stock, stirring constantly until absorbed, for about 20 minutes.
Stir in tomato sauce and mozzarella until creamy.
Garnish with fresh basil before serving.

Name: Sweet Potato & Chickpea Curry
Preparation: Peel and cube sweet potato; chop onion.
Heat olive oil in a pot, sauté onion until soft, then add curry powder.
Add sweet potato, chickpeas, and coconut milk; simmer for 20-25 minutes until tender.
Serve with rice or naan.

Name: Chicken Caesar Salad (Dinner Special)
Preparation: Grill the chicken breast until fully cooked, then slice into strips.
Chop the romaine lettuce and place in a large bowl.
Add croutons, shaved Parmesan, and dressing. Toss to combine.
Top with sliced chicken and serve immediately.

Name: Duck Confit
Preparation: Rub duck legs with salt, garlic, and thyme. Let sit for 24 hours in the refrigerator.
Rinse off the cure, pat dry, and place in a pot with melted duck fat.
Cook slowly at low heat (about 200°F/93°C) for 2-3 hours until tender.
Crisp the skin in a hot skillet before serving.

Name: Salmon and Quinoa Bowl
Preparation: Cook quinoa according to package instructions and let cool.
Season and grill or bake salmon fillet until cooked through.
Assemble bowl with quinoa, spinach, sliced avocado, and salmon.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve.

Name: Beef Stroganoff
Preparation: Slice beef into thin strips and sauté in a hot pan until browned.
Add sliced mushrooms and onions, cook until softened.
Stir in sour cream to create a creamy sauce.
Serve over cooked egg noodles.

Name: Eggplant Caviar with Crostini
Preparation: Roast eggplant in the oven at 400°F/200°C until soft, about 40 minutes.
Scoop out the flesh, mash with garlic, olive oil, and lemon juice.
Slice baguette thinly, toast until crispy.
Serve eggplant caviar with crostini on the side.

Name: Caprese Pasta Salad
Preparation: Cook pasta according to package instructions, then cool.
Halve cherry tomatoes and tear mozzarella into bite-sized pieces.
Toss pasta with tomatoes, mozzarella, basil, and balsamic vinegar.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Name: Potato Leek Soup
Preparation: Sauté chopped leeks in butter until soft.
Add diced potatoes and vegetable broth, simmer until potatoes are tender.
Blend until smooth, then stir in heavy cream.
Season with salt and pepper, serve hot.

Name: Beetroot Carpaccio
Preparation: Boil or roast beetroot until tender, then cool and peel.
Slice beetroot thinly and arrange on a plate.
Top with crumbled goat cheese, arugula, and walnuts.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve.

Name: Tomato Galette
Preparation: Roll out pie dough into a circle and spread ricotta in the center.
Slice tomatoes and arrange over ricotta, leaving a border.
Fold edges of dough over tomatoes, brush with olive oil.
Bake at 400°F/200°C for 30-35 minutes, garnish with basil.

Name: Butternut Squash Ravioli
Preparation: Roast butternut squash until soft, then mash with ricotta.
Roll out pasta dough thinly, cut into squares, and fill with squash mixture.
Seal ravioli and boil in salted water until they float.
Sauté in butter with sage leaves and serve hot.

Name: Ricotta and Spinach Cannelloni
Preparation: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
Sauté garlic in olive oil, add spinach and cook until wilted. Mix with ricotta.
Fill cannelloni tubes with the ricotta-spinach mixture.
Place in a baking dish, cover with tomato sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until golden and bubbly.

Name: Lentil Loaf
Preparation: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
Sauté onion and carrot in olive oil until soft.
Mix with lentils, breadcrumbs, egg, and tomato paste. Season to taste.
Shape into a loaf and place in a greased loaf tin.
Bake for 40-45 minutes until firm. Let cool slightly before slicing.

Name: Cheese Fondue with Veggies
Preparation: Rub the inside of a fondue pot with garlic.
Heat wine in the pot over medium heat, then gradually add cheeses, stirring until melted.
Mix cornstarch with a little water and stir into the cheese mixture to thicken.
Serve with steamed broccoli and carrot sticks for dipping.

Name: Falafel Wrap
Preparation: Blend chickpeas, onion, garlic, and parsley into a coarse paste. Form into small balls.
Heat olive oil in a pan and fry falafel balls until golden on all sides.
Place falafel, lettuce, and tahini sauce in a tortilla. Roll up tightly to serve.

Name: Steak Frites
Preparation: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Toss potatoes in olive oil, salt, and pepper, then bake for 25-30 minutes until crispy.
Season steak with salt and pepper. Heat a skillet with butter and sear steak for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Let steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing. Serve with fries.

Name: Chicken Cordon Bleu
Preparation: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
Pound chicken breast flat, place ham and cheese inside, then roll up and secure with toothpicks.
Dredge in flour, dip in egg, and coat with breadcrumbs.
Heat butter in a skillet and brown the chicken on all sides.
Transfer to oven and bake for 20-25 minutes until cooked through.

Name: Seared Scallops with Pea Puree
Preparation: Boil peas until tender, then blend with cream, butter, and salt to make a smooth puree.
Pat scallops dry and season with salt. Heat olive oil in a skillet over high heat.
Sear scallops for 2-3 minutes per side until golden. Serve on a bed of pea puree.

Name: Pork Tenderloin with Mustard Sauce
Preparation: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Season pork with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear pork on all sides. Transfer to oven and roast for 15-20 minutes.
In the same skillet, sauté garlic, add mustard and cream, and simmer until thickened.
Slice pork and serve with mustard sauce.

Name: Clam Linguine
Preparation: Cook linguine in salted water until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté garlic and red pepper flakes, then add clams and white wine.
Cover and cook until clams open (discard any that don’t).
Toss with linguine and sprinkle with parsley before serving.

Name: Lamb Chops with Rosemary
Preparation: Marinate lamb chops with olive oil, rosemary, garlic, salt, and pepper for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a skillet over high heat. Sear lamb chops for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Creamy Mushroom Pappardelle
Preparation: Cook pappardelle pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain.
Sauté garlic and mushrooms in olive oil until golden, then add cream and simmer until thickened.
Toss pasta with the creamy mushroom sauce and top with grated Parmesan.

Name: Eggplant Parmigiana
Preparation: Slice eggplant, coat in breadcrumbs, and fry in olive oil until golden.
Layer fried eggplant with tomato sauce and mozzarella in a baking dish.
Top with Parmesan and bake at 180°C for 25 minutes until bubbly and golden.

Name: French Onion Tart
Preparation: Caramelize onions in butter with thyme over low heat for 30 minutes.
Roll out puff pastry, spread caramelized onions on top, and sprinkle with Gruyère.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until pastry is golden and cheese is melted.

Name: Ratatouille (Traditional)
Preparation: Dice all vegetables into uniform pieces.
Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil, then add remaining vegetables and cook until tender.
Simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until flavors meld.

Name: Mushroom Risotto (Dinner Special)
Preparation: Sauté onion and mushrooms in butter until softened.
Add Arborio rice and stir, then gradually add hot vegetable stock, stirring until absorbed.
Continue until rice is creamy and tender, then stir in Parmesan before serving.

Name: Spinach & Ricotta Ravioli
Preparation: Cook ravioli in boiling salted water until they float to the surface, then drain.
Melt butter in a pan with sage leaves until fragrant.
Toss ravioli in the sage butter and top with grated Parmesan.

Name: Asparagus and Goat Cheese Tart
Preparation: Roll out puff pastry and place on a baking sheet.
Blanch asparagus, then arrange on pastry with crumbled goat cheese.
Brush edges with beaten egg and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.

Name: Cauliflower Cheese
Preparation: Boil cauliflower florets until tender, then drain.
Make a cheese sauce by melting butter, stirring in flour, adding milk, and melting in cheddar.
Pour sauce over cauliflower in a baking dish and bake at 180°C for 20 minutes until golden.

Name: Steak Tartare
Preparation: Finely chop beef tenderloin by hand and mix with capers, shallots, mustard, and olive oil.
Shape into a patty and make an indent for the raw egg yolk.
Serve immediately with toast points or crackers.

Name: Pork Schnitzel
Preparation: Pound pork cutlet to thin it out, then dredge in flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat in breadcrumbs.
Heat oil in a pan and fry schnitzel until golden brown on both sides.
Drain on paper towels and serve with lemon wedges.

Name: Vegetarian Cassoulet
Preparation: Chop carrots, celery, and onion into small pieces. Mince garlic.
Sauté vegetables in a pot with a little oil until softened.
Add tomato paste, thyme, and bay leaf, cooking for 2 minutes.
Stir in white beans and vegetable broth, simmer for 30 minutes.
Remove bay leaf before serving.

Name: Celeriac Steak
Preparation: Peel and slice celeriac into thick 'steaks'.
Mix olive oil, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Brush the mixture over both sides of the celeriac steaks.
Sear in a hot pan for 4-5 minutes on each side until golden and tender.
Serve hot with a side of your choice.

Name: Coq Au Vin
Preparation: Cook bacon in a large pot until crispy, then set aside.
Brown chicken thighs in the bacon fat, then remove.
Sauté chopped onion, carrots, mushrooms, and garlic in the pot.
Return chicken and bacon to the pot, add red wine, thyme, and bay leaf.
Simmer for 1 hour until chicken is tender. Remove bay leaf before serving.

Name: Beef Bourguignon
Preparation: Cook bacon in a pot until crispy, then set aside.
Brown beef chunks in bacon fat, then remove.
Sauté chopped onion, carrots, mushrooms, and garlic in the pot.
Return beef and bacon to the pot, add red wine, thyme, and bay leaf.
Simmer for 2-3 hours until beef is tender. Remove bay leaf before serving.

Name: Nicoise Salad
Preparation: Boil green beans and potatoes until tender, then cool.
Arrange tuna, green beans, potatoes, sliced tomatoes, halved eggs, and olives on a plate.
Whisk olive oil and Dijon mustard to make a dressing.
Drizzle dressing over the salad before serving.

Name: Lamb Shank with Mash
Preparation: Sear lamb shank in a hot pan until browned on all sides.
Sauté chopped onion and garlic, then add red wine and rosemary.
Return lamb to the pot, cover, and simmer for 2-3 hours until tender.
Boil potatoes until soft, then mash with butter and milk.
Serve lamb shank on a bed of mashed potatoes with sauce.

Name: Chicken Milanese
Preparation: Pound chicken breast to an even thickness.
Season with salt and pepper, then dredge in flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat with breadcrumbs.
Heat olive oil in a pan and fry chicken for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden and cooked through.
Serve with a side of salad or lemon wedges.

Name: Duck Liver Pate with Toast
Preparation: Sauté chopped onion and garlic in butter until soft.
Add duck liver and thyme, cooking until liver is just pink in the center.
Deglaze with brandy, then blend mixture until smooth.
Chill pate in the fridge for at least 2 hours.
Slice and toast baguette, then serve with pate.
image_path: data/final_images\Duck Liver Pate with Toast (Dinner Special).jpg

Name: Beef Tartare
Preparation: Finely chop beef tenderloin by hand and place in a bowl.
Add finely chopped shallot, capers, Dijon mustard, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Shape into a mound on a plate and make a small indent on top.
Place egg yolk in the indent and serve with toast or crackers.

Name: Trout Almondine
Preparation: Season trout fillet with salt and pepper, then lightly coat with flour.
Melt butter in a pan and cook trout for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden.
Remove trout and set aside. In the same pan, toast almonds in remaining butter until golden.
Add lemon juice to the pan, then pour almond sauce over the trout.
Serve immediately with a side of vegetables.

Name: Beef Wellington
Preparation: Sear the beef tenderloin on all sides, then let it cool.
Finely chop mushrooms and cook into a duxelles, then cool.
Spread pâté and duxelles over the beef, wrap in puff pastry, and brush with egg wash.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 25-30 minutes until pastry is golden and beef reaches desired doneness.

Name: Duck a l'Orange
Preparation: Score the duck skin, season, and sear skin-side down until crispy, then flip and cook briefly.
Make orange sauce by caramelizing sugar, adding orange juice, zest, and Grand Marnier, then reducing with butter.
Slice duck and drizzle with orange sauce before serving.

Name: Chicken Cordon Bleu (Dinner Special)
Preparation: Pound chicken breast flat, layer with ham and cheese, then roll tightly.
Dip in egg wash, coat with breadcrumbs, and pan-fry until golden.
Finish in the oven at 350°F (175°C) for 20 minutes until cooked through.

Name: Lamb Moussaka
Preparation: Cook ground lamb with tomato sauce and spices until thickened.
Slice and grill eggplant and potatoes until tender.
Layer potatoes, eggplant, and lamb mixture in a dish, top with béchamel sauce.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30-40 minutes until golden.

Name: Bouillabaisse
Preparation: Sauté onions, garlic, and tomatoes, then add fish stock and saffron to make broth.
Add fish and shellfish, simmering until just cooked.
Serve with crusty bread and rouille (garlic mayonnaise) on the side.

Name: Truffle Mac and Cheese
Preparation: Cook pasta until al dente, then drain.
Make cheese sauce by melting butter, adding flour, then milk, and stirring in cheese until smooth.
Mix pasta with cheese sauce, drizzle with truffle oil, and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 15 minutes.

Name: Vegetable Paella (Vegan)
Preparation: Sauté vegetables in olive oil in a paella pan.
Add rice and saffron, stirring to coat, then pour in vegetable broth.
Cook on low heat without stirring for 20-25 minutes until rice is tender and a crust forms on the bottom.

Name: Gnocchi alla Sorrentina
Preparation: Cook gnocchi in boiling water until they float, then drain.
Mix gnocchi with tomato sauce, place in a baking dish, and top with mozzarella.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 10-15 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly, garnish with basil.

Name: Mushroom Stroganoff (Dinner Special)
Preparation: Cook egg noodles until al dente, then drain.
Sauté onions and mushrooms until golden, then add vegetable broth and simmer.
Stir in sour cream to create a creamy sauce, then toss with noodles and serve.

Name: Creamed Spinach with Garlic Toast
Preparation: Blanch spinach in boiling water, then drain and chop.
Sauté garlic in butter, add spinach and cream, and cook until thickened.
Slice baguette, brush with butter and garlic, and toast until golden.
Serve creamed spinach with garlic toast on the side.

Name: Fondue (Single Serving)
Preparation: Rub the inside of a fondue pot with garlic.
Heat the white wine in the pot over medium heat, then gradually add shredded cheeses, stirring until melted.
Mix cornstarch with kirsch and stir into the cheese mixture until thickened.
Serve with bread cubes or vegetables for dipping.

Name: Coq Au Riesling
Preparation: Season and brown chicken thighs in butter in a large skillet.
Remove chicken, then sauté onions, garlic, and mushrooms in the same skillet.
Deglaze with Riesling, return chicken to the skillet, and simmer until cooked through.
Stir in heavy cream and cook until sauce thickens. Serve hot.

Name: Pork Chops with Mustard Sauce
Preparation: Season and sear pork chops in butter until golden on both sides.
Remove chops, then sauté shallots in the same pan.
Deglaze with white wine, stir in mustard and cream, and simmer until thickened.
Return chops to the pan to coat in sauce and heat through. Serve.

Name: Classic French Omelette
Preparation: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper until fully combined.
Heat butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour in eggs and stir gently with a spatula, shaking the pan to spread evenly.
Fold omelette in half when just set and slide onto a plate to serve.

Name: Salisbury Steak
Preparation: Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, chopped onion, egg, salt, and pepper; form into patties.
Cook patties in butter over medium heat until browned on both sides.
Remove patties, then make gravy by adding beef broth to the pan and simmering with onions.
Return patties to the pan, simmer in gravy, and serve hot.

Name: Chicken Kyiv
Preparation: Mix softened butter with garlic and parsley, then chill until firm.
Pound chicken breast flat, place a piece of chilled butter in the center, and roll tightly.
Dip in beaten egg, coat with breadcrumbs, and fry until golden.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20 minutes until cooked through. Serve hot.

Name: Mushroom Bourguignon
Preparation: Sauté mushrooms in olive oil until browned, then set aside.
In the same pot, cook onions, garlic, and carrots until softened.
Add red wine and vegetable broth, return mushrooms, and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with mashed potatoes or crusty bread.

Name: Eggplant Rollatini
Preparation: Slice eggplant lengthwise, brush with olive oil, and grill or bake until tender.
Mix ricotta with seasonings, spread on eggplant slices, and roll up.
Place rolls in a baking dish with marinara sauce, top with mozzarella.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20 minutes until bubbly and golden. Serve.

Name: Polenta with Roasted Vegetables
Preparation: Toss chopped vegetables with olive oil, salt, and pepper; roast at 400°F (200°C) for 25 minutes.
Cook polenta in vegetable broth, stirring until creamy and thick.
Spoon polenta onto plates and top with roasted vegetables.
Drizzle with extra olive oil and serve warm.

Name: Vegetarian Cassoulet (Dinner Special)
Preparation: Sauté onions, garlic, carrots, and celery in olive oil until softened.
Stir in tomato paste, then add white beans and vegetable broth.
Simmer for 30 minutes until flavors meld and vegetables are tender.
Top with breadcrumbs and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 15 minutes until golden. Serve.

Name: Alpine Meatballs
Preparation: Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, and finely chopped onion in a bowl.
Form into small balls and cook in a skillet over medium heat until browned and cooked through.

Name: Tuscan Ratatouille
Preparation: Chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Sauté in olive oil over medium heat until tender, season with salt and herbs.

Name: Spanish Margherita Pizza
Preparation: Roll out pizza dough on a baking sheet.
Spread tomato sauce, add mozzarella and basil, then bake at 220°C for 12-15 minutes.

Name: Tuscan Bruschetta
Preparation: Slice baguette and toast until golden.
Rub with garlic, top with diced tomatoes, and drizzle with olive oil.

Name: Mediterranean Pasta
Preparation: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
Toss with olives, crumbled feta, and olive oil.

Name: Alpine Quiche
Preparation: Place pie crust in a pie dish.
Whisk eggs, mix with cheese, pour into crust, and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes.

Name: Greek Risotto
Preparation: Sauté rice in a pan, gradually add broth, stirring until absorbed.
Stir in feta and olives before serving.

Name: Italian Ratatouille
Preparation: Dice vegetables into small pieces.
Cook in olive oil with Italian herbs until soft.

Name: Tuscan Meatballs
Preparation: Combine pork, breadcrumbs, egg, and minced garlic.
Shape into balls and simmer in tomato sauce until cooked.

Name: Greek Steak
Preparation: Marinate steak in olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano for 1 hour.
Grill or pan-sear to desired doneness.

Name: Broccoli and Cheddar Soup
Preparation: Melt butter in a pot over medium heat, add chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Add chopped broccoli and vegetable stock, bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend the mixture until smooth, return to pot, stir in cream and shredded cheddar until melted.
Season with salt and pepper, serve hot.

Name: Asparagus Risotto
Preparation: Sauté chopped onion in butter until soft in a large pan.
Add Arborio rice, stir for 2 minutes, then add white wine and cook until absorbed.
Gradually add hot vegetable stock, stirring frequently, until rice is creamy and tender (about 20 minutes).
Stir in chopped asparagus and Parmesan, cook for 5 more minutes, season with salt, and serve.

Name: Steak Frites (Dinner Special)
Preparation: Season steak with salt and pepper, sear in a hot pan with oil for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Add butter, garlic, and thyme to the pan, baste steak for 1 minute, then let rest.
Cut potatoes into fries, fry in hot oil until golden and crispy, season with salt.
Serve steak with fries on the side.

Name: Chicken Fricassee
Preparation: Brown chicken thighs in butter in a large pot, then remove and set aside.
Sauté chopped onion, carrots, and mushrooms in the same pot until softened.
Return chicken to the pot, add stock, simmer for 30 minutes until tender.
Stir in cream, season with salt, and serve hot.

Name: Prawn Linguine in White Wine
Preparation: Cook linguine in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain.
Sauté garlic in olive oil, add prawns and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes.
Add halved cherry tomatoes and white wine, simmer for 5 minutes.
Toss in cooked linguine and chopped parsley, season with salt, and serve.

Name: Beef Stroganoff (Dinner Special)
Preparation: Brown beef strips in butter in a large pan, then remove and set aside.
Sauté chopped onion and mushrooms in the same pan until soft.
Add beef stock, return beef to the pan, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in sour cream, season with salt and pepper, and serve with noodles or rice.

Name: Duck Liver Pate with Toast (Dinner Special)
Preparation: Sauté chopped onion and garlic in butter until soft.
Add duck liver, cook for 5 minutes, then deglaze with brandy and cook for 2 more minutes.
Blend the mixture with additional butter until smooth, season with salt, and chill for 2 hours.
Toast baguette slices and serve with pate.
image_path: data/final_images\Duck Liver Pate with Toast (Dinner Special).jpg

Name: Lamb Vindaloo
Preparation: Marinate lamb in vinegar, garlic, ginger, and vindaloo spice mix for 2 hours.
Sauté chopped onion in oil until golden, add chopped tomatoes, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add marinated lamb with marinade, simmer for 1 hour until tender.
Season with salt and serve with rice or naan.

Name: Lobster Thermidor
Preparation: Remove lobster meat from shell, chop, and set aside; keep shells intact.
Sauté chopped shallots in butter, add white wine, and reduce by half.
Stir in cream and mustard, simmer for 5 minutes, then add lobster meat and Parmesan.
Spoon mixture back into shells, broil until golden, season with salt, and serve.

Name: Chicken Cacciatore (Dinner Special)
Preparation: Brown chicken thighs in olive oil in a large pot, then remove and set aside.
Sauté chopped onion, bell peppers, and garlic in the same pot until softened.
Add tomatoes and white wine, return chicken to the pot, and simmer for 40 minutes.
Season with salt and serve with pasta or polenta.

Name: Eggplant Parmesan (Dinner Special)
Preparation: Slice eggplant into 1/2 inch rounds and salt them to draw out moisture for 30 minutes.
Rinse and pat dry eggplant, then dredge in breadcrumbs.
Fry eggplant slices in olive oil until golden brown.
Layer eggplant, marinara sauce, and cheeses in a baking dish.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25 minutes until cheese is bubbly and golden.

Name: Gnocchi with Gorgonzola Sauce
Preparation: Cook gnocchi in boiling salted water until they float to the surface, then drain.
In a saucepan, melt butter and add heavy cream over low heat.
Stir in crumbled Gorgonzola cheese until melted and smooth.
Toss cooked gnocchi in the sauce.
Garnish with chopped walnuts before serving.

Name: Pork Vindaloo (Traditional)
Preparation: Marinate pork in vinegar, garlic, ginger, and spices for at least 4 hours.
Heat oil in a pot and sauté chopped onions until golden.
Add marinated pork and cook until browned.
Add water, cover, and simmer for 1.5 hours until tender.
Serve hot with rice or naan.

Name: Ratatouille Stew
Preparation: Chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté onions until translucent.
Add eggplant, zucchini, and bell peppers, cooking for 10 minutes.
Stir in tomatoes and season with salt and herbs like thyme.
Simmer for 30 minutes until vegetables are tender.

Name: Tuscan Caprese
Preparation: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into 1/4 inch thick slices.
Layer tomato and mozzarella slices alternately on a plate.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between the layers.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Name: Spanish Beef Stew
Preparation: Cut beef into cubes and season with salt and pepper.
Brown beef in a pot with olive oil, then remove and set aside.
Sauté onions and carrots in the same pot until softened.
Add tomato paste and red wine, then return beef to the pot.
Add potatoes and simmer for 2 hours until beef is tender.

Name: Greek Pork Chops
Preparation: Marinate pork chops in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano for 1 hour.
Heat a grill or skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook pork chops for 4-5 minutes per side until fully cooked.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with fresh herbs if desired.

Name: Alpine Shrimp Scampi
Preparation: Peel and devein shrimp if necessary.
Melt butter in a skillet and sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Deglaze pan with white wine and lemon juice, simmering for 2 minutes.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve with pasta or bread.

Name: Spanish Caprese
Preparation: Slice tomatoes and Manchego cheese into 1/4 inch thick slices.
Layer tomato and cheese slices alternately on a plate.
Add thin slices of Serrano ham between layers.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with fresh basil leaves.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Name: Rustic Roast Chicken
Preparation: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, and rosemary.
Toss potatoes and carrots with olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Place chicken and vegetables in a roasting pan.
Roast for 45-50 minutes until chicken is golden and cooked through.

Name: Tuscan Steak
Preparation: Season the steak with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat, add garlic and rosemary.
Sear the steak for 3-4 minutes on each side for medium-rare, or to desired doneness.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Bistro-style Beef Stew
Preparation: Cut beef into cubes and brown in olive oil in a large pot.
Add chopped onions, carrots, and potatoes, and sauté for 5 minutes.
Pour in red wine and beef broth, bring to a boil, then simmer for 2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper before serving.

Name: Spanish Chicken Alfredo
Preparation: Cook fettuccine pasta according to package instructions.
Season chicken with paprika, salt, and pepper, then cook in olive oil until golden.
In the same pan, sauté garlic, add heavy cream, and stir in Parmesan until thickened.
Toss pasta and chicken in the sauce and serve hot.

Name: French Ravioli
