Preparation: Boil ravioli in salted water until they float to the surface, about 3-5 minutes.
In a pan, melt butter and add sage leaves until fragrant.
Toss cooked ravioli in the butter sauce.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese before serving.

Name: Modern Caprese
Preparation: Slice mozzarella and tomatoes into even rounds.
Layer mozzarella, tomato, and basil leaves alternately on a plate.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze before serving.

Name: Rustic Risotto
Preparation: Sauté chopped onion in butter until translucent.
Add Arborio rice and stir for 2 minutes, then pour in white wine.
Gradually add warm chicken broth, stirring constantly until absorbed, for about 20 minutes.
Stir in Parmesan cheese and serve immediately.

Name: Modern Lamb Chops
Preparation: Season lamb chops with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet, add garlic and thyme.
Sear lamb chops for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Oven-baked Bruschetta
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Slice baguette into rounds and brush with olive oil.
Bake for 5-7 minutes until golden.
Mix diced tomatoes, chopped basil, and minced garlic, then spoon onto toasted bread.

Name: Bistro-style Lamb Chops
Preparation: Season lamb chops with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet, add garlic and rosemary.
Sear lamb chops for 3-4 minutes per side, then deglaze pan with red wine.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Modern Beef Stew
Preparation: Brown beef cubes in olive oil in a large pot.
Add chopped onions, carrots, and potatoes, and sauté for 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and beef broth, bring to a boil, then simmer for 2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper before serving.

Name: Classic Bruschetta
Preparation: Slice the baguette into 1-inch thick pieces and toast until golden.
Dice tomatoes and mix with chopped basil, minced garlic, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Spoon the tomato mixture onto the toasted baguette slices and serve immediately.

Name: Hearty Margherita Pizza
Preparation: Preheat oven to 475°F (245°C).
Roll out pizza dough on a floured surface to desired thickness.
Spread tomato sauce over the dough, add slices of mozzarella, and top with basil leaves.
Drizzle with olive oil and bake for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden and cheese is melted.

Name: Tuscan Chicken Alfredo
Preparation: Cook fettuccine pasta according to package instructions and drain.
Season and cook chicken breast in a skillet until golden and fully cooked, then slice.
In the same skillet, melt butter, add minced garlic, and sauté until fragrant.
Pour in heavy cream, stir in Parmesan cheese, and season with salt and pepper until thickened.
Toss pasta and chicken in the sauce and serve hot.

Name: Gourmet Shrimp Scampi
Preparation: Cook linguine pasta according to package instructions and drain.
In a skillet, melt butter and sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook until pink, then deglaze with white wine and lemon juice.
Toss in cooked pasta and chopped parsley, then serve immediately.

Name: Spanish Pork Chops
Preparation: Season pork chops with paprika, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear pork chops on both sides until browned.
Remove pork chops, then sauté minced garlic, sliced onion, and bell peppers in the same skillet.
Add tomato sauce, return pork chops to the skillet, and simmer until fully cooked.

Name: Greek Baked Salmon
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Place salmon fillet in a baking dish, drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Season with minced garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper, then surround with cherry tomatoes.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, sprinkle with crumbled feta, and serve.

Name: Gourmet Beef Stew
Preparation: Cut beef into cubes, season with salt and pepper, and brown in olive oil in a large pot.
Remove beef, then sauté chopped onion in the same pot until translucent.
Add tomato paste, beef broth, beef, diced potatoes, and carrots, then simmer for 2 hours until tender.
Adjust seasoning and serve hot.

Name: Gourmet Gnocchi
Preparation: Cook gnocchi in boiling salted water until they float to the surface, then drain.
In a skillet, melt butter and sauté minced garlic and sage leaves until fragrant.
Add cooked gnocchi to the skillet, toss to coat, and sprinkle with Parmesan before serving.

Name: Alpine Risotto
Preparation: In a saucepan, sauté finely chopped onion in butter until translucent.
Add Arborio rice and stir to coat, then deglaze with white wine.
Gradually add warm chicken broth, stirring constantly, until rice is creamy and tender.
Stir in Parmesan cheese and serve immediately.

Name: Oven-baked Ravioli
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cook ravioli according to package instructions and drain.
In a baking dish, layer ravioli with tomato sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan.
Drizzle with olive oil, top with basil, and bake for 20 minutes until cheese is bubbly and golden.

Name: Warm Lemon Water with Cayenne Pepper
Preparation: Heat water to a warm temperature (not boiling).
Squeeze fresh lemon juice into the warm water.
Add a pinch of cayenne pepper and stir well.
Serve immediately.
image_path: data/final_images\Warm Lemon Water with Cayenne Pepper.png

Name: Soaked Almonds and Walnuts
Preparation: Place almonds and walnuts in a bowl.
Cover with water and let them soak for 6-8 hours or overnight.
Drain the water and rinse the nuts before consuming.

Name: Green Apple and Celery Juice
Preparation: Wash and chop the green apple and celery stalks into smaller pieces.
Add them to a juicer and extract the juice.
Strain if desired and serve fresh.

Name: Carrot and Ginger Shot
Preparation: Peel and chop the carrot and ginger into small pieces.
Juice them together in a juicer.
Strain if needed and serve as a small shot.

Name: Hot Water with Manuka Honey
Preparation: Heat water to a hot but drinkable temperature.
Stir in Manuka honey until fully dissolved.
Serve warm.

Name: Matcha Green Tea
Preparation: Heat water to about 80°C (not boiling).
Sift matcha powder into a bowl to avoid clumps.
Add a small amount of hot water and whisk until smooth.
Add the remaining water and whisk again before serving.

Name: Mint and Cucumber Infused Water
Preparation: Slice the cucumber thinly.
Add cucumber slices and fresh mint leaves to a pitcher of water.
Let it infuse in the refrigerator for 1-2 hours.
Serve chilled.

Name: Bamboo Extract Tea
Preparation: Heat water to about 80-90°C.
Add bamboo extract powder to a cup.
Pour hot water over the powder and stir well.
Let it steep for 2-3 minutes before drinking.

Name: Beetroot and Pomegranate Juice
Preparation: Peel and chop the beetroot into small pieces.
Extract juice from pomegranate seeds and beetroot using a juicer.
Strain if desired and serve fresh.

Name: Warm Water with Apple Cider Vinegar
Preparation: Heat water to a warm temperature (not boiling).
Add apple cider vinegar to the water and stir well.
Serve immediately.
image_path: data/final_images\Warm Water with Apple Cider Vinegar.webp

Name: Oven-baked Pork Chops
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Rub pork chops with olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Place pork chops on a baking tray and bake for 25-30 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C).
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Classic Pork Chops
Preparation: Season pork chops with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add pork chops and cook for 4-5 minutes per side or until golden brown and cooked through.
Serve hot.

Name: Oven-baked Lasagna
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a skillet, cook ground beef with chopped onion and garlic until browned, then add tomato sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Layer noodles, meat sauce, ricotta, and mozzarella in a baking dish. Repeat layers.
Top with Parmesan cheese and bake for 30-35 minutes until bubbly and golden.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.

Name: Classic Lasagna
Preparation: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a skillet, cook ground beef with chopped onion and garlic until browned, then add tomato sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Layer noodles, meat sauce, ricotta, and mozzarella in a baking dish. Repeat layers.
Top with Parmesan cheese and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30-35 minutes until bubbly and golden.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.

Name: Bistro-style Caprese
Preparation: Slice tomatoes and fresh mozzarella into even slices.
Layer tomato slices, mozzarella slices, and basil leaves alternately on a plate.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Sprinkle with salt and serve immediately.

Name: Modern Quiche
Preparation: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Place pie crust in a pie dish and prick the bottom with a fork.
In a bowl, whisk eggs, heavy cream, salt, and pepper.
Add chopped spinach and shredded cheese to the egg mixture.
Pour mixture into the pie crust and bake for 35-40 minutes until set and golden.
Let cool slightly before slicing.

Name: Gourmet Ravioli
Preparation: Cook ravioli in boiling salted water according to package instructions.
Heat tomato sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.
Drain ravioli and toss with olive oil.
Serve ravioli topped with tomato sauce, grated Parmesan, and fresh basil leaves.

Name: Italian Gnocchi
Preparation: Cook gnocchi in boiling salted water until they float to the surface, then drain.
In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat and add sage leaves until fragrant.
Add cooked gnocchi to the skillet and toss to coat in the butter and sage.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve hot.

Name: Warm Lemon Water with Honey
Preparation: Heat water in a kettle or saucepan until warm (not boiling).
Pour warm water into a mug.
Add lemon juice and honey, stirring until honey dissolves.
Serve immediately.

Name: Green Tea with Dates
Preparation: Boil water in a kettle or saucepan.
Place green tea leaves in a teapot or mug and pour hot water over them.
Let steep for 3-5 minutes, then strain if necessary.
Serve hot with dates on the side as a sweet accompaniment.

Name: Fresh Guava Juice
Preparation: Peel and chop the guava into small pieces, removing the seeds if desired.
Blend the guava pieces with water and sugar (if using) until smooth.
Strain the mixture through a fine sieve to remove pulp (optional).
Serve chilled with ice cubes if desired.

Name: Cinnamon Tea
Preparation: Boil water in a small pot or kettle.
Add the cinnamon stick to the boiling water and let it simmer for 5-10 minutes.
Remove from heat, strain if needed, and pour into a cup.
Add honey for sweetness if desired and stir well.

Name: Pumpkin Seed and Sunflower Seed Mix
Preparation: Measure equal quantities of pumpkin seeds and sunflower seeds.
Mix them together in a small bowl or container.
Optionally, lightly toast the mix in a dry pan over low heat for 2-3 minutes for added flavor.
Store in an airtight container or consume immediately as a snack.
image_path: data/final_images\Pumpkin Seed and Sunflower Seed Mix.jpg

Name: Oolong Tea
Preparation: Heat water to about 85-90°C (just below boiling).
Place oolong tea leaves in a teapot or cup.
Pour the hot water over the tea leaves and let it steep for 3-5 minutes.
Strain the tea into a cup and serve hot.

Name: Green Tea with Mint
Preparation: Heat water to about 80°C (not boiling).
Place green tea leaves and fresh mint leaves in a teapot or cup.
Pour the hot water over the leaves and let it steep for 2-3 minutes.
Strain the tea into a cup and serve hot.

Name: ABC (Apple Beetroot Carrot) Juice
Preparation: Wash, peel, and chop the apple, beetroot, and carrot into small pieces.
Add the chopped ingredients to a blender or juicer.
Blend or juice until smooth, adding water if needed for consistency.
Strain if desired and serve fresh, preferably chilled.

Name: Aloe Vera Juice
Preparation: Carefully extract the gel from a fresh aloe vera leaf by cutting it open and scooping out the clear gel.
Blend the aloe vera gel with water until smooth.
Add honey for sweetness if desired and mix well.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Name: Chia Seed Water with Lemon
Preparation: Add chia seeds to a glass of water and stir well.
Let it sit for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the seeds form a gel-like consistency.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice into the mixture and stir.
Serve at room temperature or chilled.

Name: Flaxseed Smoothie Shot
Preparation: Add flaxseeds, banana, and water or almond milk to a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a small glass or shot glass.
Serve immediately as a quick nutrient boost.

Name: Papaya Cubes
Preparation: Peel the papaya and remove the seeds.
Cut the papaya flesh into small, bite-sized cubes.
Place the cubes in a bowl or container.
Serve fresh as a snack or dessert, optionally chilled.

Name: Pomegranate Juice Shot
Preparation: Extract the seeds from a fresh pomegranate.
Blend the seeds with a little water until smooth.
Strain the mixture to remove pulp and serve as a shot.

Name: Sunflower and Pumpkin Seed Mix
Preparation: Measure equal quantities of sunflower and pumpkin seeds.
Mix them together in a small bowl or container.
Optionally, lightly roast them on low heat for added flavor before serving.

Name: Tomato Juice Shot
Preparation: Wash and chop the tomatoes into small pieces.
Blend the tomatoes with a little water until smooth.
Strain the mixture to remove pulp and serve as a shot.

Name: Guava Slices
Preparation: Wash the guava thoroughly under running water.
Cut the guava into thin slices or wedges.
Serve fresh as a snack.

Name: Orange Juice Shot
Preparation: Peel the oranges and separate the segments.
Blend or juice the orange segments to extract the juice.
Strain if desired and serve as a shot.

Name: Soaked Raisins (Kishmish) Water
Preparation: Wash the raisins thoroughly to remove any dirt.
Soak the raisins in water overnight or for at least 6-8 hours.
Drink the water along with the soaked raisins in the morning.

Name: Almond and Fig (Anjeer) Mix
Preparation: Soak the almonds and figs in water overnight (optional for softness).
Drain the water and mix them together in a small bowl.
Serve as a healthy snack.

Name: Apple Cider Vinegar (ACV) Drink
Preparation: Add 1-2 teaspoons of apple cider vinegar to a glass of water.
Optionally, add a teaspoon of honey for sweetness.
Stir well and drink on an empty stomach.

Name: Watermelon Rind Infused Water
Preparation: Wash the watermelon rind thoroughly and cut it into small pieces.
Add the rind pieces and mint leaves (if using) to a glass or jar of water.
Let it infuse for 2-3 hours in the refrigerator before drinking.

Name: Flaxseed Water
Preparation: Add 1 teaspoon of flaxseeds to a glass of water.
Let it soak overnight or for at least 6-8 hours.
Stir and drink the water (optionally strain the seeds) in the morning.

Name: Soaked Cashews
Preparation: Place cashews in a bowl and cover with water.
Let them soak for 6-8 hours or overnight.
Drain the water before consuming.

Name: Tomato and Black Pepper Shot
Preparation: Blend the tomatoes until smooth.
Strain the juice into a glass.
Add black pepper and salt, then stir well.
Serve immediately as a shot.

Name: Ginger and Lemon Warm Water
Preparation: Boil water in a small pot or kettle.
Grate or slice ginger and add it to the boiling water.
Let it simmer for 5 minutes, then remove from heat.
Strain the water into a cup, add lemon juice, and stir.

Name: Soaked Sunflower Seeds
Preparation: Place sunflower seeds in a bowl and cover with water.
Let them soak for 6-8 hours or overnight.
Drain the water before consuming.

Name: Chamomile Tea
Preparation: Boil water in a kettle or pot.
Place chamomile flowers in a cup or teapot.
Pour hot water over the flowers and let steep for 5 minutes.
Strain and serve.

Name: Banana with Peanut Butter
Preparation: Peel the banana and place it on a plate.
Spread peanut butter evenly over the banana.
Slice if desired and serve immediately.

Name: Pumpkin Seed and Warm Milk
Preparation: Heat milk in a small saucepan over low heat until warm (do not boil).
Add pumpkin seeds to the warm milk.
Stir and let sit for 2-3 minutes before drinking.

Name: Chamomile Tea with Manuka Honey
Preparation: Boil water in a kettle or pot.
Place chamomile flowers in a cup or teapot.
Pour hot water over the flowers and let steep for 5 minutes.
Strain, add Manuka honey, and stir well before drinking.

Name: Walnut and Cinnamon Infused Milk
Preparation: Heat milk in a small saucepan over low heat until warm (do not boil).
Add walnuts and cinnamon powder to the milk.
Stir well and let it sit for 5 minutes to infuse flavors.
Strain if desired and serve warm.

Name: Peppermint and Spearmint Tea
Preparation: Boil water in a kettle or pot.
Place peppermint and spearmint leaves in a cup or teapot.
Pour hot water over the leaves and let steep for 5-7 minutes.
Strain and serve.

Name: Orange and Carrot Juice Shot
Preparation: Peel the orange and carrot.
Blend them together in a juicer until smooth.
Strain the juice if desired and serve in a small glass as a shot.

Name: Lemon and Honey Warm Water
Preparation: Heat water until warm (not boiling).
Squeeze fresh lemon juice into the warm water.
Add honey and stir well until dissolved.
Serve immediately.

Name: Cucumber and Mint Detox Water
Preparation: Slice the cucumber thinly.
Add cucumber slices and mint leaves to a jug of water.
Let it infuse for 1-2 hours in the refrigerator.
Serve chilled.

Name: Aloe Vera and Honey Shot
Preparation: Extract fresh aloe vera gel from the leaf.
Blend the gel with water and honey until smooth.
Serve as a small shot.

Name: Soaked Almonds
Preparation: Place almonds in a bowl and cover with water.
Soak overnight or for 6-8 hours.
Drain the water and peel the skin if desired before consuming.

Name: Soaked Pumpkin Seeds
Preparation: Place pumpkin seeds in a bowl and cover with water.
Soak overnight or for 6-8 hours.
Drain the water and consume as a snack.

Name: Cinnamon and Honey Tea
Preparation: Boil water in a saucepan and add the cinnamon stick.
Let it simmer for 5-10 minutes.
Remove from heat, strain if needed, and stir in honey.
Serve warm.

Name: Walnut Water (Soaked Overnight)
Preparation: Place walnuts in a glass of water and soak overnight.
In the morning, drink the water and eat the soaked walnuts.

Name: Beetroot and Ginger Shot
Preparation: Peel and chop the beetroot and ginger.
Blend them together in a juicer until smooth.
Strain the juice if desired and serve as a small shot.

Name: Wheatgrass Shot
Preparation: Rinse the wheatgrass thoroughly.
Blend the wheatgrass with a small amount of water in a juicer or blender.
Strain the juice to remove pulp and serve as a shot.

Name: Flaxseed Tea
Preparation: Boil 250 ml of water in a pot.
Add 10 g of flaxseeds and let it simmer for 5-10 minutes.
Strain the mixture into a cup.
Add honey if desired for sweetness and serve warm.

Name: Aloe Vera and Cucumber Water
Preparation: Extract 30 g of fresh aloe vera gel from the leaf.
Slice 50 g of cucumber into thin rounds.
Add aloe vera gel and cucumber slices to 250 ml of water.
Let it sit for 10-15 minutes in the refrigerator before serving chilled.

Name: Warm Oat Milk with Nutmeg
Preparation: Heat 250 ml of oat milk in a saucepan over low heat until warm.
Stir in 1 g of nutmeg powder.
Add honey if desired for sweetness.
Pour into a cup and serve warm.

Name: Chia Seed Soaked Water
Preparation: Add 10 g of chia seeds to 250 ml of water in a glass.
Stir well and let it sit for 10-15 minutes until the seeds swell.
Add lemon juice if desired for flavor.
Stir again and serve at room temperature or chilled.

Name: Hibiscus Tea
Preparation: Boil 250 ml of water in a pot.
Add 5 g of dried hibiscus flowers and let it steep for 5-7 minutes.
Strain the tea into a cup.
Add honey if desired for sweetness and serve warm or chilled.

Name: Moringa Tea
Preparation: Boil 250 ml of water in a pot.
Add 5 g of dried moringa leaves and let it steep for 5-10 minutes.
Strain the tea into a cup.
Add honey if desired for sweetness and serve warm.

Name: Sesame Seed and Almond Drink
Preparation: Soak 10 g of sesame seeds and 10 g of almonds in water overnight.
Drain and blend them with 250 ml of fresh water until smooth.
Strain the mixture through a fine sieve or cheesecloth into a glass.
Add honey if desired for sweetness and serve chilled or at room temperature.

Name: Lavender Tea
Preparation: Boil 250 ml of water in a pot.
Add 3 g of dried lavender flowers and let it steep for 5-7 minutes.
Strain the tea into a cup.
Add honey if desired for sweetness and serve warm.

Name: Peanuts and Warm Soy Milk
Preparation: Heat 250 ml of soy milk in a saucepan over low heat until warm.
Crush or roughly chop 20 g of roasted peanuts.
Add the peanuts to the warm soy milk and stir.
Add honey if desired for sweetness, pour into a cup, and serve warm.

Name: Warm Water with Roasted Flaxseeds
Preparation: Heat 250 ml of water in a pot until warm (not boiling).
Add 10 g of roasted flaxseeds to the warm water.
Let it sit for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Strain if desired, pour into a cup, and serve warm.

Name: Lemon Balm Tea
Preparation: Boil 250 ml of water in a pot or kettle.
Place 10 g of fresh lemon balm leaves in a teapot or cup.
Pour the boiling water over the leaves and let it steep for 5-10 minutes.
Strain the leaves from the tea, if necessary.
Add 5 g of honey for sweetness, if desired, and stir well.
Serve hot and enjoy.

Name: Warm Water with Lemon and Mint
Preparation: Heat 250 ml of water in a pot or kettle until warm (not boiling, around 40-50°C).
Squeeze the juice of half a lemon (about 15 ml) into a cup.
Add 5 g of fresh mint leaves to the cup.
Pour the warm water over the lemon juice and mint leaves.
Let it sit for 2-3 minutes to infuse the flavors.
Stir gently and serve warm.

Name: Warm Soy Milk with Vanilla
Preparation: Pour 250 ml of soy milk into a small saucepan.
Heat the soy milk over low-medium heat until warm (do not boil, around 50-60°C).
Add 2 ml of vanilla extract to the warm soy milk and stir well.
Add 5 g of sugar or sweetener, if desired, and stir until dissolved.
Pour the warm soy milk into a cup and serve immediately.

Name: Warm Apple and Cinnamon Drink
Preparation: Heat apple juice in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add cinnamon stick and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat, stir in honey, and serve warm.

Name: Orange Blossom Water
Preparation: Mix orange blossom extract with water in a glass.
Add honey if desired and stir well.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Name: Sunflower Seed Milk
Preparation: Blend soaked sunflower seeds with water and dates (if using) until smooth.
Strain through a nut milk bag or fine sieve.
Serve chilled or store in the refrigerator.

Name: Cacao and Almond Milk (Sugar-Free Hot Chocolate)
Preparation: Heat almond milk in a saucepan over medium heat.
Whisk in cacao powder and vanilla extract until fully combined.
Serve warm.

Name: Hazelnut Milk
Preparation: Blend soaked hazelnuts with water and dates (if using) until smooth.
Strain through a nut milk bag or fine sieve.
Serve chilled or store in the refrigerator.

Name: Warm Water with Mint and Lime
Preparation: Heat water until warm (not boiling).
Add fresh mint leaves and lime juice to the water.
Let it steep for 2-3 minutes before serving.
image_path: data/final_images\Warm Water with Mint and Lime.jpg

Name: Chamomile and Mint Tea
Preparation: Boil water in a kettle or saucepan.
Add chamomile flowers and mint leaves to a teapot or cup.
Pour hot water over the herbs, steep for 5 minutes, and serve.

Name: Peppermint Tea
Preparation: Boil water in a kettle or saucepan.
Add peppermint leaves to a teapot or cup.
Pour hot water over the leaves, steep for 5 minutes, and serve.

Name: Lavender Infused Tea
Preparation: Boil water in a kettle or saucepan.
Add lavender buds to a teapot or cup.
Pour hot water over the buds, steep for 5-7 minutes, and serve.

Name: Cinnamon and Honey Milk
Preparation: Heat milk in a saucepan over medium heat.
Stir in ground cinnamon and honey until fully dissolved.
Serve warm.

Name: Rooibos Tea
Preparation: Boil water in a kettle or pot.
Place Rooibos tea leaves in a teapot or cup, pour the boiling water over them, and let steep for 5-7 minutes.
Strain the tea leaves and serve hot.

Name: Spirulina Drink
Preparation: Add spirulina powder to a glass of water.
Stir well until fully dissolved.
Add lemon juice for flavor and mix. Serve chilled if desired.

Name: Ginger and Lemon Tea
Preparation: Peel and slice fresh ginger.
Boil water in a pot, add ginger slices, and simmer for 5-10 minutes.
Strain the ginger, add lemon juice and honey (if using), stir, and serve hot.

Name: Coconut Water with a pinch of Chia Seeds
Preparation: Pour coconut water into a glass.
Add a pinch of chia seeds and stir well.
Let it sit for 5 minutes to allow chia seeds to swell, then drink.

Name: Cinnamon and Honey Water
Preparation: Boil water in a kettle or pot.
Add cinnamon powder to the hot water and let it steep for 5 minutes.
Stir in honey until dissolved and serve warm.

Name: Blackstrap Molasses Drink
Preparation: Heat water until warm (not boiling).
Stir in blackstrap molasses until fully dissolved.
Add lemon juice if desired, mix well, and serve warm.

Name: Golden Milk with Maca Powder
Preparation: Heat almond milk in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add turmeric, maca powder, and a pinch of black pepper, stirring until well combined.
Sweeten with honey if desired, and serve warm.

Name: Macadamia Nut Milk
Preparation: Soak macadamia nuts in water for 4-6 hours or overnight.
Drain and blend the nuts with 250 ml of fresh water and dates (if using) until smooth.
Strain through a nut milk bag or fine mesh strainer, and serve chilled.

Name: Jasmine Tea
Preparation: Boil water in a kettle or pot.
Place jasmine tea leaves in a teapot or cup, pour the boiling water over them, and let steep for 3-5 minutes.
Strain the tea leaves and serve hot.

Name: Hemp Seed Milk
Preparation: Blend hemp seeds with 250 ml of water and dates (if using) until smooth.
Strain through a nut milk bag or fine mesh strainer if desired (optional, as hemp milk is often fine unstrained).
Serve chilled or store in the refrigerator.
